                                            POST
                                            /inventory

                                            Schedules import inventory job based on the input. 4 formats (Content-Types) are supported:

                                            • ZIP format (application/zip) - file previously export by GET /inventory
                                            • CSV format (text/csv)
                                            • Nmap report XML file (application/xml)
                                            • Nmap report XML file supported with CSV properties file (multipart/form-data)

                                            Full URL: /velocity/api/inventory/v5/inventory

                                            Access Level: Admin

                                            Request Body:

                                            Either ZIP, CSV or XML data depending on provided Content-Type.

                                            If you are going to import Nmap report XML file supported with CSV properties file, you are expected to post multipart request body containing Nmap report XML file (Content-Type: application/xml) and CSV properties file (Content-Type: text/csv).

                                            Returns:

                                            Scheduled job ID.

                                            If a CSV file was imported, job’s successful result is JSON object with the following fields:

                                            • imported (object) - statistics about imported devices
                                              • total (number) - total number of objects to be imported
                                              • imported (number) - number of successfully imported devices
                                              • skipped (number) - always 0, because it is not used for CSV import
                                              • failed (number) - number of objects that were not imported due to an error
                                            • removed (object) - statistics about removed devices
                                              • total (number) - total number of objects to be removed
                                              • removed (number) - number of successfully removed devices
                                              • failed (number) - number of objects that were not removed due to an error
                                            • details (list) - list of objects describing import result for every particular object:
                                              • id (string) - UUID of the imported or removed object (null if the object operation was not successful)
                                              • name (string) - name of the imported or removed object
                                              • type (string) - one of “DEVICE”, “PORT”
                                              • status (string) - one of “IMPORTED”, “SKIPPED”, “FAILED” OR “REMOVED”
                                              • message (string) - message describing why the object was skipped or failure reason (null when status is “IMPORTED” OR “REMOVED”)

                                            For other supported import formats, job’s successful result is JSON object with the following fields:

                                            • total (number) - total number of objects to be imported
                                            • imported (number) - number of successfully imported devices
                                            • skipped (number) - number of objects that were not imported because they already exist in the inventory
                                            • failed (number) - number of objects that were not imported due to an error
                                            • details (list) - list of size total with objects describing import result for every particular object:
                                              • id (string) - UUID of the imported object (null if the object was not imported)
                                              • name (string) - name of the imported object
                                              • type (string) - one of “DEVICE”, “PORT”, “DRIVER”, “TEMPLATE”
                                              • status (string) - one of “IMPORTED”, “SKIPPED”, “FAILED”
                                              • message (string) - message describing why the object was skipped or failure reason (null when status is “IMPORTED”)

                                            Response example for job result is shown below as “Response 200”

                                            Tags:

                                            • asynchronous

                                            Error Codes:

                                            • MAX_SIZE_EXCEEDED - request body is too big - more than 64 MB
                                            • TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND - template specified in parameters was not found
                                            • BAD_TEMPLATE - the specified templateId is not a Device template, or portTemplateId is not a Port template
                                            • Parameters
                                            • templateId
                                              string (optional) 

                                              UUID of an inventory template and is a default for devices to import. Used for CSV and Nmap import. It is mandatory for the latter.

                                              portTemplateId
                                              string (optional) 

                                              UUID of an inventory template and is a default for ports to import. Used for CSV import.

                                              fileName
                                              string (optional) 

                                              Name of file which will be used as import source

                                            • Response  200Toggle
                                            • Body
                                              {
    "status": "SUCCESS",
    "result": {
        "total": 3,
        "imported": 2,
        "skipped": 1,
        "failed": 0,
        "details": [
            {
                "id": "cc7b967f-79a5-4fc6-a6b7-bf6e4c00c89c",
                "name": "lab-gw.mylab.local",
                "type": "DEVICE",
                "status": "IMPORTED",
                "message": null
            },
            {
                "id": "dc835676-c751-4229-ba0f-46d49f12ae0a",
                "name": "switch3.mylab.local",
                "type": "DEVICE",
                "status": "IMPORTED",
                "message": null
            },
            {
                "id": null,
                "name": "dutcisco3750.mylab.local",
                "type": "DEVICE",
                "status": "SKIPPED",
                "message": "Resource `dutcisco3750.mylab.local` already exists"
            }
        ]
    },
    "errorMessage": null
}

                                            GET
                                            /physical_connections_csv

                                            Exports physical connections into a CSV file.

                                            Full URL: /velocity/api/inventory/v5/physical_connections_csv

                                            Access Level: User

                                            Returns:

                                            A CSV file with exported physical connections, containing the following columns:

                                            • device1 (string) - name of the first connected device
                                            • port1 (string) - name of the first connected port
                                            • place1 (string) - link place of the first connected port, can be one of “BACK” or “FRONT”
                                            • type (string) - type of a connection link, can be one of “FIXED” or “DYNAMIC”
                                            • device2 (string) - name of the second connected device
                                            • port2 (string) - name of the second connected port
                                            • place2 (string) - link place of the second connected port, can be one of “BACK” or “FRONT”
                                            • Request  export physical connections to CSVToggle
                                            • Headers
                                              Content-Type: text/csv
                                            • Response  200Toggle
                                            • Headers
                                              Content-Type: text/csv
                                              Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=physical_connections.csv
                                              Body
                                              device1,port1,place1,type,device2,port2,place2
Sunnyvale MRV Switch,1.1.2,BACK,FIXED,Server #1,s1.2,BACK
Sunnyvale MRV Switch,1.1.1,BACK,FIXED,Server #1,s1.1,BACK
Sunnyvale MRV Switch,1.1.3,BACK,FIXED,Server #1,s1.3,BACK
                                            POST
                                            /physical_connections_csv

                                            Schedules a new physical connections import job based on the passed CSV data.

                                            Full URL: /velocity/api/inventory/v5/physical_connections_csv

                                            Access Level: Admin

                                            Request Body:

                                            CSV data containing the same set of columns from the corresponding export request. If a connection place is not specified, it is “FRONT” by default. If a connection type is not specified, it is “FIXED” by default. If it is needed to remove a connection, you are expected not to fill data about one of the connected ports.

                                            Returns:

                                            Scheduled job ID.

                                            Job’s successful result is JSON object with the following fields:

                                            • imported (object) - statistics about imported connections
                                              • total (number) - total number of connections to be imported
                                              • imported (number) - number of successfully imported connections
                                              • skipped (number) - always 0, because it is not used for connections import
                                              • failed (number) - number of connections that were not imported due to an error
                                            • removed (object) - statistics about removed connections
                                              • total (number) - total number of connections to be removed
                                              • removed (number) - number of successfully removed connections
                                              • failed (number) - number of connections that were not removed due to an error
                                            • details (list) - list of connections describing import result for every particular connection:
                                              • id (string) - always null, because it is not used for connections import
                                              • name (string) - string representation of the imported or removed connection
                                              • type (string) - “PHYSICAL_LINK”
                                              • status (string) - one of “IMPORTED”, “FAILED” OR “REMOVED”
                                              • message (string) - message describing the failure reason (null when status is “IMPORTED” OR “REMOVED”)

                                            Response example for job result is shown below as “Response 200”.

                                            Tags:

                                            • asynchronous

                                            Error Codes:

                                            • MAX_SIZE_EXCEEDED - request body is too big - more than 64 MB
                                            • Response  200Toggle
                                            • Body

                                            Topology Service v6 

                                            GET
                                            /folders

                                            Returns full structure of the topologies folder

                                            Full URL: /velocity/api/topology/v6/folders

                                            Access Level: User

                                            Returns:

                                            Folder tree. Each folder is represented as a JSON object with the following fields:

                                            • id (string) - UUID of the folder (null for root folder)
                                            • name (string) - name of the folder (“Root Folder” for root folder)
                                            • parentId (string) - UUID of the parent folder (null when parent is root; also null for the root folder itself)
                                            • topologyCount (number) - number of topologies in the folder
                                            • folders (list) - list of sub-folders with the same fields
                                            • Response  200Toggle

                                              GET
                                              /topologies

                                              Returns list of topologies and current user’s drafts with basic information.

                                              Full URL: /velocity/api/topology/v6/topologies

                                              Access Level: User

                                              Returns:

                                              List of all published topologies as well as current user’s drafts. Every topology has the same set of fields as returned by GET /topology/{topologyId}. If there is no condition for activeReservationCount in the filter, it returns null for this field. Use filter=activeReservationCount:!:0 if you need active topologies, filter=activeReservationCount::0 if you need inactive ones and filter=activeReservationCount:!:-1 if you need all topologies with counted active reservations.

                                              Tags:

                                              • pageable
                                              • sortable by any of result field, except “isActual” and “isAutomaticallyModified”
                                              • filterable by id, name, isDraft, isValid, isAbstract, activeReservationCount, creatorId, lastModifierId, lastAction, folderId (to get topologies from root folder use ROOT as a value for folderId filter)
                                              • Parameters
                                              • searchString
                                                string (optional) 

                                                if specified, only topologies whose names or descriptions match the string are returned

                                                forResource
                                                string (optional) 

                                                UUID of an inventory resource. If specified, only topologies containing the resource are returned

                                                forPortGroup
                                                string (optional) 

                                                UUID of a resource port group. If specified, only topologies affected by port group are returned. Must be passed with forResource.

                                                includeOnlyLastRevisions
                                                boolean (optional) 

                                                if specified as true, only last revisions will be returned

                                                includeRemoved
                                                boolean (optional) 

                                                if specified as true, will be also included removed topologies

                                              GET
                                              /topology/{topologyId}

                                              Returns either information about the topology specified by topologyId in JSON format, or TBML data representing the topology.

                                              Full URL: /velocity/api/topology/v6/topology/{topologyId}

                                              Access Level: User

                                              Returns:

                                              If JSON is requested:

                                              • id (string) - UUID of the topology
                                              • versionId (string) - UUID of the current version
                                              • name (string) - name of the topology
                                              • description (string) - topology description
                                              • isRemoved (boolean) - true if the topology is removed, false otherwise
                                              • isValid (boolean) - true if the topology is valid (no problems), false otherwise
                                              • isAbstract (boolean) - true if the topology contains abstract resources, false otherwise
                                              • isDraft (boolean) - true if the topology is draft (visible only to current user), false otherwise
                                              • isActual (boolean) - true if it is actual (last) revision of topology, false otherwise
                                              • “isAutomaticallyModified (boolean) - true if last topology update was made automatically (e. g. background subtopology update).
                                              • isVirtual (boolean) - true if the topology contains virtual resources, false otherwise
                                              • containsAbstractCloud (boolean) - true if the topology contains virtual resources that reference to abstract cloud (Any Cloud), false otherwise
                                              • revision (number) - revision number (1-based)
                                              • folderId (string) - UUID of the topology folder (null for root folder)
                                              • activeReservationCount *(number) - number of active reservations
                                              • lockStatus (object) - status of the edit lock for the topology
                                                • isLocked (boolean) - true if the topology is locked for editing, false otherwise
                                                • lockOwnerId (string) - UUID of the user owning edit lock on the topology (null if not locked)
                                                • lockClientId (string) - ID of the client that owns the lock (passed to POST /topology/{topologyId}/lock)
                                                • lockAcquired (number) - timestamp when the lock was acquired (null if not locked)
                                                • lockExpires (number) - timestamp when the lock will expire (null if not locked)
                                              • creatorId (string) - UUID of the creator of the topology
                                              • created (number) - creation timestamp
                                              • lastModifierId (string) - UUID of the user that performed the last modification
                                              • lastModified (number) - last modification timestamp
                                              • lastAction (string) - “CREATED”/“MODIFIED”/“LOCKED”/“RELEASED”/“AUTO_MODIFIED”

                                              If TBML is requested:

                                              Representation of the topology in TBML format

                                              Error Codes:

                                              • TOPOLOGY_NOT_FOUND - The topology was not found
                                              • Parameters
                                              • topologyId
                                                string (required) 

                                                UUID of the topology

                                                asFile
                                                boolean (optional) Default: false 

                                                when true, TBML data representing the topology is returned, and the Accept header value, if any, is ignored

                                              GET
                                              /topology/{topologyId}/resources

                                              Access Level: User

                                              Returns:

                                              • resources (list)
                                                • id (string) - UUID of the resource
                                                • name (string) - name of the resource in topology
                                                • parentId (string) - UUID of parent resource
                                                • parentName (string) - name of the resource parent in topology
                                                • inventoryResourceId (string) - UUID of associated resource in inventory (can be null for abstract resource)
                                                • inventoryResourceName (string) - inventory name of the resource (can be null for abstract resource)
                                                • inventoryParentResourceId (string) - inventory ID of the resource parent (null for devices)
                                                • inventoryParentResourceName (string) - inventory name of the resource parent (null for devices)
                                                • originalId (string) - id of the resource in topology
                                                • condition (string) - abstract resource mapping condition (null for non-abstract resource)
                                                • isShared (boolean) - true when the resource is in shared use, false when in exclusive use
                                                • problemCode (string) - string representing resource problem code (can be null if there is no problem; see GET /topology/{topologyId}/problems)

                                              Error Codes:

                                              • TOPOLOGY_NOT_FOUND - The topology was not found

                                              GET
                                              /topology/{topologyId}/state

                                              Return state of topology elements (devices, ports and connections)

                                              Full URL: /velocity/api/topology/v6/topology/{topologyId}/state

                                              Access Level: User

                                              Returns:

                                              • elements (list)
                                                • originalId (string) - ID of the resource (device, port or connection) in topology
                                                • properties (list) - list of properties that values can dynamically changed
                                                  • groupName (string) - name of the property group containing this property
                                                  • name (string) - name of the property
                                                  • value (string) - value of the property (can be null, meaning “no value-
                                                • status (object) - current status of topology resource
                                                  • code (string) - status code, one of “UNKNOWN”, “ACTIVATING”, “ACTIVE”, “DEACTIVATING”, “INACTIVE”, “FAILED”
                                                  • name (string) - status name for represent in UI
                                                  • description (string) - status description for represent in UI
                                                  • transitional (boolean) - true if this status is intermediate, false for stable state
                                                • actions (list) - actions that can be performed for this topology resource
                                                  • code (string) - action code
                                                  • name (string) - action name for represent in UI
                                                  • description (string) - action description for represent in UI
                                                  • isEnabled (boolean) - is action currently enabled
                                                  • type (string) - action type, one of “HTTP_GET”, “HTTP_POST”, “HTTP_PUT”, “HTTP_DELETE” (HTTP method call) or “OPEN_URL” go to the URL address
                                                  • href (string) - action URL, RESTful method call or external page address, depends of action type
                                                  • isJob (boolean) - true if this action is job, for such actions JSON object with jobId is returned as response, see Job Service.

                                              Error Codes:

                                              • TOPOLOGY_NOT_FOUND - the topology was not found

                                              GET
                                              /topology/{topologyId}/problems

                                              For the specified topology, returns the list of devices, ports and links that have validation errors.

                                              Full URL: /velocity/api/topology/v6/topology/{topologyId}/problems

                                              Access Level: User

                                              Returns:

                                              List of:

                                              • originalId (string) - ID of topology resource, port or link
                                              • propertyGroupName (string) - group name of resource or port property (null if problem not related to specific property)
                                              • propertyId (string) - ID of resource or port property (null if problem not related to specific property)
                                              • problemCode (string) - problem code
                                              • problemDescription (string) - human readable problem description

                                              The following problem codes exist for resources:

                                              • RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND - Resource or port is not found in the inventory
                                              • RESOURCE_DISABLED - Resource or port is disabled
                                              • RESOURCE_OUT_OF_SERVICE - Resource is out of service
                                              • INVALID_RESOURCE_INTERFACE - L1, L2 switches and Patch Panels are not supported in logical topologies
                                              • RESOURCE_NAME_NOT_UNIQUE - Resource name is not unique in the topology
                                              • INVALID_PARENT - Resource has invalid parent reference
                                              • BAD_VLAN - VLAN cannot be resolved to physical connections for connected resources
                                              • BAD_RESOURCE_CONDITION - Abstract resource has unrecognized condition syntax
                                              • BAD_CONNECTIVITY_VALUE - Connectivity property has incorrect value
                                              • BAD_CONNECTIVITY_PORT_HAS_TOPOLOGY_LINK - Disconnected port must have no topology links

                                              The following problem codes exist for links:

                                              • BAD_VLAN - VLAN cannot be resolved to physical connections for connected resources
                                              • BAD_CONNECTION - Link cannot be resolved to physical connection
                                              • BAD_VLAN_ID - VLAN has an invalid ID(s) assigned to it.
                                              • VLAN_ISOLATED - VLAN has no connections.
                                              • MULTI_VLAN_PORT_ISOLATED - Multi-VLAN port has no connection.
                                              • VLAN_ID_NOT_SPECIFIED - Both untagged VLAN ID and tagged VLAN IDs are not specified.

                                              The following problem codes exist for virtual topology links:

                                              • BAD_VIRTUAL_CONNECTION - Wrong link between virtual (cloud) resources, virtual machine or virtual router can be connected only to virtual network
                                              • BAD_DIFFERENT_CLOUD_CONNECTION - Wrong link between virtual resources from different cloud

                                              The following problem codes exist for virtual topology resource:

                                              • BAD_CIDR_FORMAT - subnet CIDR property not in valid format
                                              • BAD_IP_FORMAT - IP address property not in valid format
                                              • BAD_MAC_FORMAT - MAC address property not in valid format
                                              • BAD_INTEGER_FORMAT - integer property not in valid format
                                              • IP_NOT_IN_VALID_RANGE - IP address of port not in subnet range
                                              • IMAGE_NOT_SPECIFIED* - no one image related properties not specified (should be specified imageId or/and one or more image matching property)
                                              • PUBLIC_IP_POOL_NOT_FOUND - value specified for “Public IP Pool” property do not refer to existing public network
                                              • NO_ROUTE_TO_PUBLIC_IP_POOL - from port with specified “Public IP Pool” property no route to corresponding public network
                                              • NOT_CONNECTED_PORT - virtual resource cannot contain not connected port, every port of VM or router must be connected to virtual network
                                              • SUBNET_RANGES_CONFLICT - subnet ranges of virtual network intersects with already used subnet range of other virtual network
                                              • INVALID_HARDWARE_PROFILE - hardware profile is incorrectly configured (Should be specified Hardware Profile or all three fields: Min CPU Cores, Min RAM MB, Min Disc GB)

                                              Error Codes:

                                              • TOPOLOGY_NOT_FOUND - The topology was not found
                                              • Parameters
                                              • topologyId
                                                string (required) 

                                                UUID of the topology

                                              • Response  200Toggle
                                              • Body

        {
          "originalId":"resource_0",
          "propertyGroupName":null,
          "propertyId":null,
          "problemCode":"RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND",
          "problemDescription": "Resource is not found in the inventory"
        }
      ]
    }

                                                      Reservation Service v6 

                                                      Reservation service allows to schedule and manage topology or resource reservations.

                                                      GET
                                                      /reservations

                                                      Lists all reservations for the specified time period

                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservations

                                                      Access Level: User

                                                      Returns:

                                                      For every reservation:

                                                      • id (string) - UUID of the reservation
                                                      • name (string) - name of the reservation
                                                      • description (string) - reservation description
                                                      • start (number) - timestamp when the reservation starts
                                                      • end (number) - timestamp when the reservation ends for non-recurring reservations, timestamp when the reservation schedule ends for recurring reservation
                                                      • duration (number) - duration of reservation in seconds for non-recurring reservations, for recurring duration of every reservation event
                                                      • status (string) - one of the following values:
                                                        • STANDBY - reservation is waiting until the work order is completed
                                                        • PENDING_APPROVAL - only for future reservations, means that the reservation is waiting for approval and will become failed if nobody approves it
                                                        • PENDING_ESCALATION_REQUEST - means that this reservation cannot be started because of conflicts with another reservations. Reservation pending until decision from escalation manager that can cancel conflicting reservations to fulfill given reservation
                                                        • SCHEDULED - reservation is scheduled for the future
                                                        • ACTIVATING - activation procedures are in progress (including startup tasks)
                                                        • ACTIVE - reservation is active
                                                        • DEACTIVATING - deactivation procedures are in progress (including teardown tasks)
                                                        • COMPLETED - reservation was completed in the past
                                                        • SUSPENDED - only for recurrent reservations; meaning is somewhat similar to “Cancel”, but cancelling recurrent reservations cancels only future events, and the reservation itself gets “Suspended” status
                                                        • DECLINED - reservation was declined
                                                        • FAILED - failed by some reason: canceled by user, not approved before start, etc.
                                                        • TERMINATED - reservation was aborted by escalation manager
                                                        • UNKNOWN - only for private reservations when details are hidden for requesting user
                                                      • topologyId (string) - UUID of reserved topology (can be null if only inventory resources are reserved)
                                                      • topologyVersionId (string) - UUID of reserved topology version (can be null if only inventory resources are reserved)
                                                      • cloudId (string) - UUID of the cloud that is set for the resources from “Abstract Cloud”. Make sense only for reservation of virtual topology that contain references to abstract cloud. Passed cloud used in the topology instead abstract cloud.
                                                      • parentId (string) - UUID of parent recurring reservation (null for single reservation that is not part of a recurring reservation)
                                                      • isRecurrent (boolean) - true for recurring reservations
                                                      • recurrence (object) - object describing recurrence of the reservation (null for non-recurring). Contains the following fields:
                                                        • type (string) - one of “HOURLY”, “DAILY”, “WEEKLY”, “MONTHLY”
                                                        • interval (number) - per how many hours should the reservation repeat (meaningless for types other than “HOURLY”)
                                                        • daysOfWeek (list) - on which days of week should the reservation repeat (list of strings, each can be one of “SUN”, “MON”, “TUE”, “WED”, “THU”, “FRI”, “SAT”; meaningless for types other than “WEEKLY”)
                                                      • isAbstract (boolean) - true if the reservation contains abstract resources
                                                      • isResolved (boolean) - true if the reservation is resolved
                                                      • failReason (string) - string representing reservation failure reason (null for non-failed reservations)
                                                      • requiresCheckIn (boolean) - true if reservation owner has(had) to check in when the reservation starts
                                                      • isCheckedIn (boolean) - true if the reservation owner checked-in to the reservation (meaningless if requiresCheckIn is false)
                                                      • requestResolutionUserId (string) - UUID of the user who approved or declined the reservation (null if the decision was not made or approval is not needed)
                                                      • escalationRequestId (string) - UUID of the related escalation request, not null only if reservation was created with status PENDING_ESCALATION_REQUEST
                                                      • alternativeGroupParentId (string) - UUID of the parent alternative reservation
                                                      • intervalToRunEndTestCase (number) - execution offset in seconds from the end of a reservation for test case that should run near end of reservation
                                                      • notes (string) - reservation notes
                                                      • creatorId (string) - UUID of the creator of the reservation
                                                      • created (number) - creation timestamp
                                                      • lastModifierId (string) - UUID of the user who performed the last modification
                                                      • lastModified (string) - last modification timestamp
                                                      • recurrenceIndex (number) - recurrence index, starts from 1, meaningful for events of recurrence reservations, will be null for non-events.

                                                      Tags:

                                                      • pageable
                                                      • sortable by any field except recurrence, intervalToRunEndTestCase, cloudId, status
                                                      • filterable by name, status, topologyId, topologyVersionId, parentId, isRecurrent, isAbstract, isResolved, requiresCheckIn, isCheckedIn, requestResolutionUserId, creatorId, creatorGroupId, lastModifierId, resourceId, resourceGroupId, escalationRequestId, alternativeGroupParentId
                                                      • Use “NONE” as a value for parentId filter to get top-level reservations
                                                      • Use “NONE” as a value for resourceGroupId filter to get reservations containing ungrouped resources
                                                      • Use “NONE” as a value for creatorGroupId filter to get reservations created by ungrouped users
                                                      • Parameters
                                                      • searchString
                                                        string (optional) 

                                                        if specified, only reservations whose names match the string are returned

                                                        approverId
                                                        string (optional) 

                                                        if specified, only reservations assigned to an approver are returned

                                                        startAfter
                                                        number (optional) 

                                                        timestamp of the beginning of custom period (if specified, only reservations that intersect with given period are returned)

                                                        endBefore
                                                        number (optional) 

                                                        timestamp of the ending of custom period (if specified, only reservations that intersect with given period are returned)

                                                        onlyActivated
                                                        boolean (optional) 

                                                        if true, only reservations that have been in ACTIVE status are returned

                                                      • Response  200Toggle

                                                      GET
                                                      /reservation/{reservationId}

                                                      Returns reservation specified by reservationId

                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservation/{reservationId}

                                                      Access Level: User

                                                      Returns:

                                                      What is returned by GET /reservations plus the following fields:

                                                      • events (list) - collection of reservation events, empty list if a reservation is not recurrent
                                                        • id (string) - UUID of the event
                                                        • start (number) - timestamp when the event starts
                                                        • end (number) - timestamp when the event ends
                                                        • status (string) - status of the reservation event, one of the following values:
                                                          • SCHEDULED - reservation is scheduled for the future
                                                          • ACTIVATING - activation procedures are in progress (including startup tasks)
                                                          • ACTIVE - reservation is active
                                                          • DEACTIVATING - deactivation procedures are in progress (including teardown tasks)
                                                          • COMPLETED - reservation was completed in the past
                                                          • FAILED - failed by some reason: canceled by user, not approved before start, etc.
                                                      • hasAlternatives (boolean) - true, if reservation has alternatives
                                                      • testCaseExecutions (list) - information about test case executions attached to the reservation, scheduled after a reservation starts, near end or manually launched
                                                        • id (string) - test case execution UUID (It isn’t test case UUID)
                                                        • testCaseId (string) - test case UUID
                                                        • name (string) - name of the test case
                                                        • type (string) - test case execution schedule type, one of “SCHEDULED_AT_START”, “MANDATORY_AT_START”, “SCHEDULED_NEAR_END”, “MANDATORY_NEAR_END” or “MANUALLY_LAUNCHED”
                                                        • status (string) - string representing the test case execution status, one of “NOT_BEGUN”, “IN_PROGRESS”, “START_FAILED”, “DISPATCHING”, “COMPLETED”, “ABORTED”, “AGENT_NOT_RESPONDING”, “QUEUED”
                                                        • assetId (string) - test case asset UUID
                                                        • started (number) - timestamp when the test case was queued for an execution
                                                        • finished (number) - timestamp when the execution finished
                                                        • result (string) - string representing the test case execution result
                                                        • response (string) - string representing the test case execution response
                                                        • reportUrl (string) - string representing the test case report url (can be null)
                                                        • parameters (list) - list of test case execution parameters
                                                          • name (string) - name of the parameter
                                                          • value (string) - value of the parameter
                                                          • description (string) - description of the parameter
                                                        • agentRequirements (list) - list of test case agent requirements:
                                                          • name (string) - name of the agent requirement
                                                          • value (string) - value of the agent requirement
                                                      • request (object) - request form filled by the owner of the reservation (null if it was not required):
                                                        • formName (string) - request form name
                                                        • userGroupId (string) - UUID of the group on whose behalf the request is made
                                                        • fields (list) - list of objects representing form fields:
                                                          • name (string) - name of the field
                                                          • value (string) - value of the field (can be null, meaning no value, always null for type: “PASSWORD”)
                                                          • type (string) - field type, one of “TEXT”, “TEXT_AREA”, “BOOLEAN”, “DECIMAL”, “INTEGER”, “ATTACHMENT”, “PASSWORD” or “DROP_DOWN_LIST”
                                                          • groupName (string) - name of the field group containing the field
                                                          • availableValues (list) - used only for “DROP_DOWN_LIST” type, list of available values
                                                      • attendees (list) - list of objects representing reservation attendees:
                                                        • userId (string) - UUID of user - reservation attendee (null if email is specified)
                                                        • email (string) - Email of reservation attendee (null if userId is specified)

                                                      Error Codes:

                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND - The reservation was not found
                                                      • Parameters
                                                      • reservationId
                                                        string (required) 

                                                        UUID of the reservation

                                                      • Response  200Toggle
                                                      • Body

                                                      GET
                                                      /reservation/{reservationId}/resources

                                                      Returns list of resources reserved for the reservation specified by reservationId

                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservation/{reservationId}/resources

                                                      Access Level: User

                                                      Returns:

                                                      List of resources reserved in the reservation, each containing the following fields:

                                                      • name (string) - name of the resource
                                                      • type (string) - resource type (“DEVICE” or “PORT”)
                                                      • isTopologyResource (boolean) - true if the resource if reserved from topology, false otherwise
                                                      • utilizationType (string) - utilization type of the resource. One of “SHARED”, “EXCLUSIVE”.
                                                      • isConfigurable (boolean) - true if resource interface is one of the following: “CONFIGURABLE”, “CONFIGURABLE_LAYER1_SWITCH”, “CONFIGURABLE_LAYER2_SWITCH”, false otherwise
                                                      • isResolved (boolean) - true when the abstract topology resource is resolved or the resource was added in topology resolving, false otherwise
                                                      • inventoryResourceId (string) - inventory ID of the resource (null for abstract topology resource)
                                                      • inventoryResourceName (string) - inventory name of the resource (null for abstract topology resource)
                                                      • inventoryParentResourceId (string) - inventory ID of the resource parent (null for devices)
                                                      • inventoryParentResourceName (string) - inventory name of the resource parent (null for devices or if includeInventoryParentResourceName query parameter not true)
                                                      • topologyResourceId (string) - topology ID of the resource (null when isTopologyResource is false)
                                                      • topologyParentResourceId (string) - topology ID of the resource parent (null for devices)
                                                      • configAssetId (string) - UUID of configuration asset to upload at the start of the reservation
                                                      • firmwareAssetId (string) - UUID of firmware asset to upload at the start of the reservation
                                                      • restoreDefaultConfig (boolean) - true if config and firmware should be restored to default at the end of the reservation
                                                      • condition (string) - abstract resource resolving condition

                                                      Tags:

                                                      • pageable
                                                      • filterable by any field except inventoryParentResourceName

                                                      Error Codes:

                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND - The reservation was not found
                                                      • Parameters
                                                      • reservationId
                                                        string (required) 

                                                        UUID of the reservation

                                                        includeInventoryParentResourceName
                                                        boolean (optional) Default: false 

                                                        if true, returns inventoryParentResourceName. Otherwise, the field has null value.

                                                        searchString
                                                        string (optional) 

                                                        returns resources that have name or parent name matching the search string

                                                      • Response  200Toggle
                                                      • Body

                                                      POST
                                                      /reservation

                                                      Creates new reservation

                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservation

                                                      Access Level: User

                                                      Request Body:

                                                      JSON object with a subset of the following fields:

                                                      • name (string, required) - name of the reservation (mandatory)
                                                      • description (string, optional) - reservation description (“” by default)
                                                      • start (number, optional) - timestamp when the reservation starts (immediate by default; mandatory for recurring reservations)
                                                      • end (number, optional) - timestamp when the reservation ends (mandatory for non-recurring reservations)
                                                      • duration (number, optional) - duration in seconds (mandatory for recurring reservations)
                                                      • topologyId (string, optional) - UUID of the topology to reserve (can be null or omitted if only inventory resources are reserved or topologyVersionId is specified)
                                                      • topologyVersionId (string, optional) - UUID of the topology version to reserve (can be null or omitted if only inventory resources are reserved or topologyId is specified)
                                                      • cloudId (string) - UUID of the cloud that is set for the resources from “Abstract Cloud”. Make sense only for reservation of virtual topology that contain references to abstract cloud. Passed cloud used in the topology instead abstract cloud.
                                                      • isRecurrent (boolean, optional) - true for recurring reservations (false by default)
                                                      • recurrence (object, optional) - object describing recurrence of the reservation (mandatory when isRecurrent is true). Contains the following fields:
                                                        • type (string, required) - one of “HOURLY”, “DAILY”, “WEEKLY”, “MONTHLY”
                                                        • interval (number, optional) - per how many hours should the reservation repeat (meaningless for types other than “HOURLY”)
                                                        • daysOfWeek (list, optional) - on which days of week should the reservation repeat (list of strings, each can be one of “SUN”, “MON”, “TUE”, “WED”, “THU”, “FRI”, “SAT”; meaningless for types other than “WEEKLY”)
                                                      • resources (list, optional) - list of reserved inventory resources with the following fields (mandatory if topologyId is null):
                                                        • inventoryResourceId (string, required) - inventory ID of the resource (mandatory)
                                                        • inventoryParentResourceId (string, optional) - inventory ID of the parent resource (null for devices, not null for ports)
                                                        • utilizationType (string, required) - resource utilization type, one of “SHARED”, “EXCLUSIVE”, “INHERIT”. When “INHERIT” is specified, the utilization type is inherited from the parent template.
                                                        • configAssetId (string, optional) - UUID of config asset to apply to the resource when the reservation starts (null by default)
                                                        • firmwareAssetId (string, optional) - UUID of firmware asset to apply to the resource when the reservation starts (null by default)
                                                        • restoreDefaultConfig (boolean, optional) - true if default config and firmware should be restores when the reservation ends (true by default)
                                                      • intervalToRunEndTestCase (number, optional) - execution offset in seconds from the end of a reservation for test case that should run near end of reservation
                                                      • startTestCases (list) - list with information about test cases attached to the reservation, executable after a reservation starts:
                                                        • testCaseId (string) - UUID of the test case
                                                        • parameters (list) - list of test case execution parameters:
                                                          • name (string) - name of the parameter
                                                          • value (string) - value of the parameter
                                                        • agentRequirements (list) - list of test case agent requirements:
                                                          • name (string) - name of the agent requirement
                                                          • value (string) - value of the agent requirement
                                                      • endTestCases (list) - list with information about test cases to run after the reservation ends:
                                                        • testCaseId (string) - UUID of the test case
                                                        • parameters (list) - list of test case execution parameters:
                                                          • name (string) - name of the parameter
                                                          • value (string) - value of the parameter
                                                        • agentRequirements (list) - list of test case agent requirements:
                                                          • name (string) - name of the agent requirement
                                                          • value (string) - value of the agent requirement
                                                      • request (object, optional) - request form - object containing the following fields (null by default):
                                                        • userGroupId (string, required) - UUID of the group on whose behalf the request is made
                                                        • fields (object, required) - list of fields with the following attributes:
                                                          • formFieldId (string, required) - UUID of corresponding form field
                                                          • value (string, optional) - field value (default value is used when omitted)
                                                      • notes (string, optional) - reservation notes (null by default)
                                                      • attendees (object, optional) - list of objects representing reservation attendees:
                                                        • userId (string, required) - UUID of user - reservation attendee (must be null if email is specified, mandatory otherwise)
                                                        • email (string, required) - Email of reservation attendee (must be null if userId is specified, mandatory otherwise)
                                                      • resolution (object, optional) - object containing resolve resolution for reserving topology (meaningless if topologyId is null or isRecurrent is true, must be null if customConditions is specified). If not specified, resolving process will be performed asynchronously after the reservation is created (i.e. after this request returns successful result). Resolve resolution object can be obtained as a response of POST /topology/{topologyId}/resolution
                                                      • resolutions (list, optional) - list of resolutions objects. Meaningful when escalationRequest and topologyId are specified.
                                                      • customConditions (list, optional) - list of objects representing custom conditions for abstract resources (null by default, must be null if resolution is specified).
                                                        • topologyResourceId (string, required) - topology ID of the resource
                                                        • condition (string, required) - custom condition for topology resource
                                                      • customUtilizations (list, optional) - list of objects representing custom utilization for topology resources (meaningless if topologyId is null).
                                                        • topologyResourceId (string, required) - topology ID of the resource
                                                        • utilizationType (string, required) - resource utilization type, one of “SHARED”, “EXCLUSIVE”, “INHERIT”. When “INHERIT” is specified, the utilization type is inherited from the parent template.
                                                      • customLinkConditions (list, optional) - list of objects representing custom conditions for topology link, takes effect only when topologyId is specified (null by default).
                                                        • topologyLinkId (string, required) - topology ID of the link
                                                        • condition (string, required) - custom condition for topology link
                                                      • workOrder (object, optional) - object containing work order creation data (meaningless if resolution is null or resolution doesn’t contain items in manualConnections list, mandatory otherwise):
                                                        • assigneeId (string) - UUID of technician or technician manager who performs the requested work order
                                                        • completeBefore (number) - timestamp when the work order should be completed (value must be between start and end)
                                                        • notes (string, optional) - work order notes (null by default)
                                                      • escalationRequest (object, optional) - object containing escalation request creation data. With providing escalation request user can create reservation that conflict with existing reservations. Reservation will be created with status PENDING_ESCALATION_REQUEST, escalation request will be sent to escalation manager.
                                                        • name (string, required) - name of escalation request
                                                        • description (string, optional) - description of escalation request
                                                        • assigneeId (string, required) - ID of assignee of escalation request. User must be member of escalation managers group
                                                        • validUntil (number, required) - timestamp when escalation request should be expired
                                                        • resolutionSets (list, required) - list of resolution set. A resolution set means that if all the reservations in list were canceled or re-scheduled, the requested reservation can be fulfilled. Resolution set can be obtained by POST /conflicts
                                                          • number (number) - number of resolution set can be used for order resolution sets.
                                                          • conflicts (list) - list of resolution set conflicts, each conflict include reservation and list of resources and VLANs which are involved in the conflict
                                                            • reservationId (object) - ID of conflicting reservation
                                                            • resourceIds (list) - list of conflicting with given reservation inventory resource IDs
                                                              • id (string) - UUID of the inventory resource
                                                            • vlanIds (list) - list of conflicting with given reservation VLAN IDs

                                                      Returns:

                                                      Created reservation, the same as if returned by GET /reservation/{reservationId}

                                                      Error Codes:

                                                      • RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND - Specified resource does not exist in the inventory
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_NOT_FOUND - Specified topology does not exist
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_IS_DRAFT - Specified topology is in draft state
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_DISABLED - Specified topology is disabled
                                                      • APPROVAL_REQUIRED - Because the reservation requires approval, it cannot be updated as an immediate reservation
                                                      • SCHEDULE_ERROR - Cannot create the reservation because one of the following: Start time is in the past, has zero duration, or does not include a start date. A recurring reservation does not include a duration, recurrence information or end date. See the message for details.
                                                      • BAD_RESOURCE_CONDITION - The resource condition for one or more resources is malformed
                                                      • BAD_TOPOLOGY_LINK_CONDITION - The condition for one or more topology link is malformed
                                                      • USER_GROUP_NOT_FOUND - Reservation request misses User Group
                                                      • RESERVATION_RESOURCE_DUPLICATE - Cannot reserve same resource multiple times in one reservation
                                                      • NOTHING_RESERVED - User tried to create an empty reservation
                                                      • RESERVATION_CONFLICT - Some of the specified resources for this reservation or its resolve resolution are being used in other reservation at the specified time. Notice that unless resolution is provided, the immediate conflicts will only be detected for concrete resources in the reservation. If the resolving process fails after the reservation is created, the reservation’s status will become FAILED.
                                                      • MANDATORY_FIELD_MISSING - Reservation Request has required field but with undefined value.
                                                      • INVALID_VALUE_TYPE - Reservation Request includes invalid values (for example, expected number but got string )
                                                      • PROPERTY_BAD_ENUM_VALUE - The value attribute of Reservation Request field of type “DROP_DOWN_LIST” has a value that is not included in the availableValues list of the corresponding Request Form field
                                                      • INVALID_EMAIL_ADDRESS - The additionalEmails attribute contains invalid Email address
                                                      • RESERVATION_END_TEST_CASE_INVALID_INTERVAL - The test case must start before the reservation finishes. Specify a positive number of minutes.
                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_ABSTRACT - Topology of reservation is not abstract but resolution contain resolved abstract resources
                                                      • CONDITIONS_ALREADY_RESOLVED - resolution and conditions are both specified.
                                                      • BAD_TOPOLOGY_RESOURCE_ID - topologyResourceId specified in customConditions is not valid.
                                                      • DUPLICATED_TOPOLOGY_RESOURCE_ID - topologyResourceId specified in customConditions is duplicated.
                                                      • WORK_ORDER_COMPLETE_BEFORE_AFTER_RESERVATION_END - the value of completeBefore field of workOrder is greater than the value of reservation’s end field
                                                      • WORK_ORDER_COMPLETE_BEFORE_AFTER_RESERVATION_END_TEST_CASE - completeBefore date of workOrder should be less than the end test case execution time
                                                      • WORK_ORDER_BAD_RESERVATION_TYPE - workOrder is specified when isRecurrent value is true
                                                      • WORK_ORDER_RESERVATION_IS_IMMEDIATE - workOrder is specified when the reservation is immediate
                                                      • RESERVATION_WORK_ORDER_INSUFFICIENT_ALLOCATED_TIME - allocated time to respond to work order is too small (start date of the reservation is too close)
                                                      • RESERVATION_WORK_ORDER_ASSIGNEE_MANAGER_REQUIRED - work order assignee is not a technician manager, and the admin configured that only managers can be initially assigned to work orders
                                                      • RESERVATION_CONFLICT_VLAN - the reservation has conflicting VLANs
                                                      • BAD_RESOLUTIONS_COUNT - the reservation has bad resolutions
                                                      • Parameters
                                                      • ignoreVlanConflicts
                                                         (optional) 

                                                        indicates that VLAN conflicts must be ignored
