                                                      PUT
                                                      /reservation/{reservationId}

                                                      Updates reservation.

                                                      If reservation is in one of the following states, only listed fields could be modified:

                                                      • Reservation has started - notes, description, duration and/or end
                                                      • Reservation has failed - notes, description
                                                      • Reservation has been approved - notes, description

                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservation/{reservationId}

                                                      Access Level: User

                                                      Request Body:

                                                      JSON object with any subset of the following fields:

                                                      • name (string, optional) - new name for the reservation
                                                      • description (string, optional) - new reservation description
                                                      • start (number, optional) - new timestamp when the reservation starts
                                                      • end (number, optional) - new timestamp when the reservation ends
                                                      • duration (number, optional) - new duration in seconds
                                                      • isRecurrent (boolean, optional) - true for recurring reservations. Cannot be changed from true to false.
                                                      • recurrence (object, optional) - object describing new recurrence of the reservation. May contain a subset of the following fields:
                                                        • type (string, optional) - new recurrence type. one of “HOURLY”, “DAILY”, “WEEKLY”, “MONTHLY”
                                                        • interval (number, optional) - new recurrence interval - per how many hours should the reservation repeat (meaningless for type other than “HOURLY”)
                                                        • daysOfWeek (list, optional) - on which days of week should the reservation repeat (list of strings, each can be one of “SUN”, “MON”, “TUE”, “WED”, “THU”, “FRI”, “SAT”; meaningless for types other than “WEEKLY”)
                                                      • resources (list, optional) - new list of reserved inventory resources with the following fields:
                                                        • inventoryResourceId (string, required) - inventory ID of the resource
                                                        • inventoryParentResourceId (string, optional) - inventory ID of the parent resource (null for devices, not null for ports)
                                                        • utilizationType (string, required) - resource utilization type, one of “SHARED”, “EXCLUSIVE”, “INHERIT”. When “INHERIT” is specified, the utilization type is inherited from the parent template.
                                                        • configAssetId (string, optional) - UUID of config asset to apply to the resource when the reservation starts (null by default)
                                                        • firmwareAssetId (string, optional) - UUID of firmware asset to apply to the resource when the reservation starts (null by default)
                                                        • restoreDefaultConfig (boolean, optional) - true if default config and firmware should be restores when the reservation ends (true by default)
                                                      • startTestCases (list) - list with information about test cases attached to the reservation, executable after a reservation starts:
                                                        • testCaseId (string) - UUID of the test case
                                                        • parameters (list) - list of test case execution parameters:
                                                          • name (string) - name of the parameter
                                                          • value (string) - value of the parameter
                                                        • agentRequirements (list) - list of test case agent requirements:
                                                          • name (string) - name of the agent requirement
                                                          • value (string) - value of the agent requirement
                                                      • endTestCases (list) - list with information about test cases to run after the reservation ends:
                                                        • testCaseId (string) - UUID of the test case
                                                        • parameters (list) - list of test case execution parameters:
                                                          • name (string) - name of the parameter
                                                          • value (string) - value of the parameter
                                                        • agentRequirements (list) - list of test case agent requirements:
                                                          • name (string) - name of the agent requirement
                                                          • value (string) - value of the agent requirement
                                                      • intervalToRunEndTestCase (number, optional) - execution offset in seconds from the end of a reservation for test case that should run near end of reservation
                                                      • notes (string, optional) - reservation notes (null by default)
                                                      • resolution (object, optional) - object containing resolve resolution for reserving topology (meaningless if topologyId is null or isRecurrent is true). Resolve resolution object can be obtained as response of POST /topology/{topologyId}/resolution
                                                      • customUtilizations (list, optional) - list of objects representing custom utilization for topology resources (meaningless if only inventory resources are reserved)
                                                        • topologyResourceId (string, required) - topology ID of the resource
                                                        • utilizationType (string, required) - resource utilization type, one of “SHARED”, “EXCLUSIVE”, “INHERIT”. When “INHERIT” is specified, the utilization type is inherited from the parent template.
                                                      • workOrder (object, optional) - object containing work order creation data (meaningless if resolution is null or resolution doesn’t contain items in manualConnections list, mandatory otherwise):
                                                        • assigneeId (string) - UUID of technician or technician manager who performs the requested work order
                                                        • completeBefore (number) - timestamp when the work order should be completed (value must be between start and end)

                                                      Returns:

                                                      Updated reservation, the same as if returned by GET /reservation/{reservationId}

                                                      Error Codes:

                                                      • RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND - The specified resource does not exist in the inventory
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_NOT_FOUND - Specified topology does not exist
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_DISABLED - Specified topology is disabled
                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND - The specified reservationId does not refer to an existing reservation
                                                      • APPROVAL_REQUIRED - Because the reservation requires approval, it cannot be converted to an immediate reservation
                                                      • RESERVATION_IS_RECURRENT - Cannot convert recurring reservation to single execution
                                                      • RESERVATION_RESOURCE_DUPLICATE - Cannot reserve same resource multiple times in one reservation
                                                      • SCHEDULE_ERROR - Cannot update the reservation because one of the following: Start time is in the past, has zero duration, or does not include a start date. A recurring reservation does not include a duration, recurrence information or end date. See the message for details.
                                                      • BAD_RESOURCE_CONDITION - The resource condition for one or more resources is malformed
                                                      • RESERVATION_CONFLICT - Some of the specified resources for this reservation or its resolve resolution are being used in other reservation at the specified time
                                                      • RESERVATION_END_TEST_CASE_INVALID_INTERVAL - The test case must start before the reservation finishes. Specify a positive number of minutes.
                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_ABSTRACT - Topology of reservation is not abstract but resolution contain resolved abstract resources
                                                      • WORK_ORDER_COMPLETE_BEFORE_AFTER_RESERVATION_END - the value of completeBefore field of workOrder is greater than the value of reservation’s end field
                                                      • WORK_ORDER_COMPLETE_BEFORE_AFTER_RESERVATION_END_TEST_CASE - completeBefore date of workOrder should be less than the end test case execution time
                                                      • WORK_ORDER_BAD_RESERVATION_TYPE - workOrder is specified when isRecurrent value is true
                                                      • WORK_ORDER_RESERVATION_IS_IMMEDIATE - workOrder is specified when the reservation is immediate
                                                      • RESERVATION_WORK_ORDER_INSUFFICIENT_ALLOCATED_TIME - allocated time to respond to work order is too small (start date of the reservation is too close)
                                                      • RESERVATION_WORK_ORDER_ASSIGNEE_MANAGER_REQUIRED - work order assignee is not a technician manager, and the admin configured that only managers can be initially assigned to work orders
                                                      • RESERVATION_CONFLICT_VLAN - the reservation has conflicting VLANs
                                                      • Parameters
                                                      • reservationId
                                                        string (required) 

                                                        UUID of the reservation to update

                                                        ignoreVlanConflicts
                                                         (optional) 

                                                        indicates that VLAN conflicts must be ignored

                                                      POST
                                                      /topology/{topologyId}/resolution

                                                      Returns resolution for the specified topology

                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/topology/{topologyId}/resolution

                                                      Access Level: User

                                                      Request Body:

                                                      JSON object with a subset of the following fields:

                                                      • start (number, required) - timestamp when the expected reservation of the topology starts (mandatory)
                                                      • end (number, required) - timestamp when the expected reservation of the topology ends (mandatory)
                                                      • excludeReservationId (string, optional) - ID of reservation, which resources will not affect resolution candidates list (null by default)
                                                      • allowResourcesConflicts (boolean, optional) - if true, resources reserved between start and end time will not be excluded from candidates list (false by default).
                                                      • allowResolutionAlternatives (boolean, optional) - if true then in case when resolution has conflict with existing reservations, generate additional alternative resolution. allowResourcesConflicts is ignored in this case and considered as true
                                                      • customConditions (list, optional) - list of topology resource conditions (empty by default):
                                                        • topologyResourceId (string, required) - topology resource ID of the abstract resource (mandatory)
                                                        • condition (string, required) - custom condition for required topology resource (mandatory)
                                                      • customLinkConditions (list, optional) - list of topology link conditions (empty by default):
                                                        • topologyLinkId (string, required) - ID of a topology link (mandatory)
                                                        • condition (string, required) - custom condition for required topology link (mandatory)
                                                      • customUtilizations (list, optional) - list of topology resource utilization (empty by default):
                                                        • topologyResourceId (string, required) - topology resource ID of the abstract resource (mandatory)
                                                        • utilizationType (string, required) - custom utilization for required topology resource (mandatory)

                                                      Returns:

                                                      Scheduled job ID. Job’s successful result is JSON object containing topology resolution, used in POST /reservation. Note: In case when allowResolutionAlternatives is true returned list of resolution object instead of single resolution object

                                                      • resolvedResources (list) - map of resolved topology resources where keys are topology resource IDs in string format.
                                                        • originalResourceId (string) - temporary resource ID generated during resolve process
                                                        • originalResourceParentId (string) - temporary resource’s parent ID generated during resolve process (may be null)
                                                        • inventoryResourceUuid (string) - resource UUID
                                                        • inventoryResourceParentUuid (string) - resource parent UUID (may be null)
                                                        • name (string) - name of the resource
                                                        • parentName (string) - name of the parent resource (null for devices)
                                                        • type (string) - either “device” or “port”
                                                        • condition (string) - abstract resource mapping condition (null for non-abstract resource)
                                                        • isConfigurable (boolean) - true if resource interface is one of the following: “CONFIGURABLE”, “CONFIGURABLE_LAYER1_SWITCH”, “CONFIGURABLE_LAYER2_SWITCH”, false otherwise
                                                      • additionalResources (list) - list of the additional resources
                                                        • id (string) - ID of the resource
                                                        • name (string) - name of the resource
                                                        • parentId (string) - ID of the resource parent (null for devices)
                                                        • parentName (string) - name of the resource parent (null for devices)
                                                        • isShared (boolean) - true when the resource is in shared use, false when in exclusive use
                                                      • links (list) - list of activation links
                                                        • id (string) - id of the link in the topology
                                                        • resource1 (object) - first resource in the link with the same fields as in resolvedResources
                                                        • resource2 (object) - second resource in the link with the same fields as in resolvedResources
                                                        • isBidirectional (boolean) - true if the link is bidirectional
                                                        • isPortLink (boolean) - true if the link is between two ports
                                                      • vlans (list) - list of resolved VLANs
                                                        • id (string) - id of the VLAN in the topology
                                                        • name (string) - name of the VLAN in the topology
                                                        • userProvidedId (string) - optional VLAN ID
                                                        • resources (list) - list of resources that the VLAN contains. Every resource has the same fields as in resolvedResources
                                                      • multiVlans (list) - list of resolved Multi-VLANs, grouped by VLAN ID
                                                        • id (string) - id of the Multi-VLAN in the topology
                                                        • name (string) - name of the Multi-VLAN in the topology
                                                        • groups (list) - list of groups that the VLAN contains. Every group has the following structure
                                                          • vlanId (number) - VLAN ID of the group
                                                          • taggedPorts (list) - list of tagged ports that the VLAN contains. Every port has the same fields as in resolvedResources
                                                          • untaggedPorts (list) - list of untagged ports that the VLAN contains. Every port has the same fields as in resolvedResources
                                                      • manualConnections (list) - list of manual connection actions
                                                        • type (string) - type of a connection action, can be one of “CONNECT” or “DISCONNECT”
                                                        • port1Id (string) - ID of the first inventory port
                                                        • port2Id (string) - ID of the second inventory port
                                                        • linkPlace1 (string) - a link place of the first port, can be one of “BACK” or “FRONT”
                                                        • linkPlace2 (string) - a link place of the second port, can be one of “BACK” or “FRONT”
                                                        • topologyLinkId (string, optional) - optional ID of a topology link which caused the connection action
                                                        • port1Name (string, optional) - a name of the first port
                                                        • resource1Id (string, optional) - ID of a parent resource of the first port
                                                        • resource1Name (string, optional) - name of a parent resource of the first port
                                                        • port2Name (string, optional) - a name of the second port
                                                        • resource2Id (string, optional) - ID of a parent resource of the second port
                                                        • resource2Name (string, optional) - name of a parent resource of the second port

                                                      Tags:

                                                      • asynchronous

                                                      Error Codes:

                                                      • RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND - Specified resource does not exist in the inventory
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_NOT_FOUND - Specified topology does not exist
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_DISABLED - Specified topology is disabled
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_INVALID - Specified topology is invalid
                                                      • INTERNAL_ERROR - Cannot read tbml of the specified topology
                                                      • BAD_RESOURCE_CONDITION - The resource condition for one or more resources is malformed
                                                      • RESOLVE_FAILED - Unable to find resolution for the specified topology at the specified interval
                                                      • RESERVATION_CONFLICT_VLAN - the reservation has conflicting VLANs
                                                      • Parameters
                                                      • topologyId
                                                        string (required) 

                                                        UUID of the topology

                                                      GET
                                                      /reservation/{reservationId}/topology/links

                                                      Returns list of topology links from reservation perspective, abstract resources substituted with resolved inventory resources.

                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservation/{reservationId}/topology/links

                                                      Access Level: User

                                                      Returns:

                                                      • links (list)
                                                        • id (string) - ID of the link
                                                        • isPortLink (boolean) - true in case the link is between resource ports
                                                        • resource1 (object) - a source resource; represented similarly to GET /topology/{topologyId}/resources
                                                        • parentResource1 (object) - a parent of a source resource; represented similarly to GET /topology/{topologyId}/resources
                                                        • resource2 (object) - a destination resource; represented similarly to GET /topology/{topologyId}/resources
                                                        • parentResource2 (object) - a parent of a destination resource; represented similarly to GET /topology/{topologyId}/resources
                                                        • bidirectional (boolean) - if true then the link is bidirectional, otherwise the link is oriented from resource1 to resource2
                                                        • connectionTypeName (string) - name of a connection type
                                                        • condition (string) - an inventory condition for a topology link
                                                        • problemCode (string) - string representing link problem code (can be null if there is no problem; see GET /topology/{topologyId}/problems)

                                                      Error Codes:

                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND - The reservation was not found
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_NOT_FOUND - The topology was not found
                                                      • Parameters
                                                      • reservationId
                                                        string (required) 

                                                        UUID of the reservation

                                                        onlyPortLinks
                                                        boolean (optional) 

                                                        when true only links between resource ports are returned

                                                      • Response  200Toggle

                                                      GET
                                                      /reservation/{reservationId}/state

                                                      Return state of reserved topology elements (devices, ports and connections). This endpoint works only for reservations of topologies.

                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservation/{reservationId}/state

                                                      Access Level: User

                                                      Returns:

                                                      • isReady (boolean) - true if no background work is performed for this reservation
                                                      • elements (list)
                                                        • originalId (string) - ID of the resource (device, port or connection) in topology
                                                        • properties (list) - list of properties that values can dynamically changed
                                                          • groupName (string) - name of the property group containing this property
                                                          • name (string) - name of the property
                                                          • value (string) - value of the property (can be null, meaning “no value-
                                                        • status (object) - current status of topology resource
                                                          • code (string) - status code, one of “UNKNOWN”, “ACTIVATING”, “ACTIVE”, “DEACTIVATING”, “INACTIVE”, “FAILED”
                                                          • name (string) - status name for represent in UI
                                                          • description (string) - status description for represent in UI
                                                          • transitional (boolean) - true if this status is intermediate, false for stable state
                                                        • actions (list) - actions that can be performed for this topology resource
                                                          • code (string) - action code
                                                          • name (string) - action name for represent in UI
                                                          • description (string) - action description for represent in UI
                                                          • isEnabled (boolean) - is action currently enabled
                                                          • type (string) - action type, one of “HTTP_GET”, “HTTP_POST”, “HTTP_PUT”, “HTTP_DELETE” (HTTP method call) or “OPEN_URL” go to the URL address
                                                          • url (string) - action URL, RESTful method call or external page address, depends of action type
                                                          • isJob (boolean) - true if this action is job, for such actions JSON object with jobId is returned as response, see Job Service.

                                                      Error Codes:

                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND - the reservation was not found
                                                      • RESERVATION_INACTIVE - The reservation is not currently active
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_NOT_FOUND - the topology was not found
                                                      • Parameters
                                                      • reservationId
                                                        string (required) 

                                                        UUID of the reservation

                                                      • Response  200Toggle
                                                      • Body
                                                        {

        "value": "192.168.10.7"

      ],
      "status": {
        "code": "ACTIVE",

        "transitional": false
        },

      },
      {
      "originalId": "resource_1",
      "properties" [
        {
        "groupName": "Networking",

        }
      ],
      "status": {

        "description": "",
        "transitional": false
        },
      "actions": []
      },

                                                      POST
                                                      /reservation/{reservationId}/execution

                                                      Start test case execution during active reservation

                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservation/{reservationId}/execution

                                                      Access Level: User

                                                      Request Body: JSON object with a test case UUID:

                                                      • testCaseId (required, string) - UUID of test case to execute
                                                      • parameters (list, optional) - list of test case parameter with the following fields
                                                        • name (string, required) - name of the test case parameter
                                                        • value (string, optional) - value of the test case parameter
                                                        • description (string, optional) - description of the test case parameter
                                                      • agentRequirements (list, optional) - list of agent requirements with the following fields
                                                        • name (string, required) - name of the agent requirement
                                                        • value (string, optional) - value of the agent requirement

                                                      Returns:

                                                      • id (string) - test case execution UUID (It isn’t test case UUID)
                                                      • name (string) - name of the test case
                                                      • type (string) - test case execution schedule type (“MANUALLY_LAUNCHED”)
                                                      • assetId (string) - test case asset UUID
                                                      • started (number) - timestamp when the test case was queued for an execution
                                                      • finished (number) - timestamp when the execution finished
                                                      • result (string) - result of test case execution - one of “PASS”, “FAIL”, “INDETERMINATE”, “ABORT”.
                                                      • reportUrl (string) - string representing the test case report link (can be null)

                                                      Error Codes:

                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND - the reservation was not found
                                                      • TEST_CASE_NOT_FOUND - test case with specified ID was not found
                                                      • RESERVATION_INACTIVE - The reservation is not currently active
                                                      • RequestToggle
                                                      • Body
                                                            {
      "testCaseId": "23e05a4a-ac97-463d-a79b-ba98dbbce612",
      "parameters": []
    }
                                                      • Response  200Toggle
                                                      • Body
                                                            {
        "id": "906a70d2-bd3d-42c7-8853-adf369b4b667",
        "name": "Get device info",
        "type": "MANUALLY_LAUNCHED",
        "assetId": "70cba95c-f1ce-4a62-a757-870a406a51c4",
        "started": null,
        "finished": null,
        "isFailed": false,
        "response": null,
        "reportUrl": null
    }

                                                      POST
                                                      /reservation/{reservationId}/topology/lock

                                                      For the current user, attempts to create an edit lock for the topology of the reservation specified by reservationId

                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservation/{reservationId}/topology/lock

                                                      Access Level: User

                                                      Returns:

                                                      The same as if returned by POST /topology/{topologyId}/lock

                                                      Error Codes:

                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND - the reservation was not found
                                                      • NOT_TOPOLOGY_RESERVATION - the reservation is not associated with a topology
                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_EDITABLE - the reservation is not in editable state(it’s failed, cancelled, in the past, or requires approval)
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_ALREADY_LOCKED - the topology of the reservation is already locked for editing
                                                      • Parameters
                                                      • reservationId
                                                        string (required) 

                                                        UUID of the reservation

                                                        duration
                                                        number (optional) Default: 600 

                                                        lock duration in seconds (optional, up to 600 seconds)

                                                        clientId
                                                        string (optional) 

                                                        ID provided by client to identify itself. This can be used solely for client-side checking of lock ownership when retrieving lock status. The application does not use this ID when client updates topology. (empty string by default)

                                                      • Response  200Toggle
                                                      • Body
                                                            {
      "expires": 1342526312000
    }
                                                      PUT
                                                      /reservation/{reservationId}/topology/lock

                                                      For the current user, attempts to refresh the lock for the topology of the reservation specified by reservationId

                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservation/{reservationId}/topology/lock

                                                      Access Level: User

                                                      Returns:

                                                      The same as if returned by PUT /topology/{topologyId}/lock

                                                      Error Codes:

                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND - the reservation was not found
                                                      • NOT_TOPOLOGY_RESERVATION - the reservation is not associated with a topology
                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_EDITABLE - the reservation is not in editable state(it’s failed, cancelled, in the past, or requires approval)
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_NOT_LOCKED - the topology of the reservation is not currently locked for editing
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_LOCKED_BY_OTHER_USER - the topology of the reservation is locked for editing by another user
                                                      • Parameters
                                                      • reservationId
                                                        string (required) 

                                                        UUID of the reservation

                                                        duration
                                                        number (optional) Default: 600 

                                                        lock duration in seconds (optional, up to 600 seconds)

                                                      • Response  200Toggle
                                                      • Body
                                                            {
      "expires": 1342526312000
    }
                                                      DELETE
                                                      /reservation/{reservationId}/topology/lock

                                                      Deletes edit lock for the topology of the reservation specified by reservationId (unlocks the topology).

                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservation/{reservationId}/topology/lock

                                                      Access Level: User

                                                      Error Codes:

                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND - the reservation was not found
                                                      • NOT_TOPOLOGY_RESERVATION - the reservation is not associated with a topology
                                                      • RESERVATION_NOT_EDITABLE - the reservation is not in editable state(it’s failed, cancelled, in the past, or requires approval)
                                                      • TOPOLOGY_NOT_LOCKED - the topology of the reservation is not currently locked for editing
                                                      • Parameters
                                                      • reservationId
                                                        string (required) 

                                                        UUID of the reservation

                                                        POST
                                                        /reservation/{reservationId}/topology

                                                        Updates the topology of the reservation specified by reservationId with the TBML representation that is provided

                                                        Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservation/{reservationId}/topology

                                                        Access Level: User

                                                        Request Body:

                                                        TBML that describes a topology with content type ‘application/xml’ or ‘application/tbml’

                                                        Returns:

                                                        • jobId (string) - scheduled job ID. If reservation is active now this job is incrementally activating topology job, if reservation is not active job ID is null.

                                                        Error Codes:

                                                        • RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND - the reservation was not found
                                                        • NOT_TOPOLOGY_RESERVATION - the reservation is not associated with a topology
                                                        • RESERVATION_NOT_EDITABLE - the reservation is not in editable state(it’s failed, cancelled, in the past, or requires approval)
                                                        • RESERVATION_BUSY - the reservation cannot be modified at the moment because background work is performed for it
                                                        • RESOLVE_FAILED - failed to resolve the topology
                                                        • MAX_SIZE_EXCEEDED - TBML file exceeds maximum upload size (16 MB)
                                                        • TOPOLOGY_NOT_LOCKED - Could not lock the topology for editing
                                                        • TOPOLOGY_LOCKED_BY_OTHER_USER - Another user has already locked the topology for editing
                                                        • TOPOLOGY_LOCKED_BY_OTHER_CLIENT - Specified clientId does not match clientId of the acquired lock
                                                        • BAD_TBML - TBML file contains validation errors
                                                        • RESERVATION_CONFLICT_VLAN - the reservation has conflicting VLANs
                                                        • Parameters
                                                        • reservationId
                                                          string (required) 

                                                          UUID of the reservation to update it’s topology

                                                          clientId
                                                          string (optional) 

                                                          ID of the client making the update (empty string by default)

                                                          ignoreVlanConflicts

                                                        POST
                                                        /reservation/{reservationId}/action

                                                        Performs an action on the reservation specified by reservationId

                                                        The “cancel” action does the following:

                                                        • If single:
                                                          • stop active reservation
                                                          • cancel new inactive reservation
                                                        • If recurring:
                                                          • cancel the whole reservation if it has no active event
                                                          • stop active event if it has an active event

                                                        The “teardown” action launches the teardown task then stops the reservation

                                                        Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservation/{reservationId}/action

                                                        Access Level: User

                                                        Error Codes:

                                                        • RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND - The specified reservationId does not refer to an existing reservation
                                                        • RESERVATION_DECLINED - Reservation was declined and cannot be modified
                                                        • RESERVATION_FINISHED - Reservation has already finished and cannot be modified
                                                        • RESERVATION_FAILED - Reservation has failed and cannot be modified
                                                        • NOT_RESERVATION_OWNER - The current user cannot check in because the reservation was created by another user
                                                        • NOT_APPROVER - Because the current user is not the Approver for the reservation request, the current user cannot approve or decline the reservation
                                                        • NOT_CHECK_IN_TIME - Either you cannot yet check in to the reservation (N minutes before start) or check-in time has already expired
                                                        • APPROVAL_NOT_REQUIRED - Reservation does not require approval
                                                        • DECLINE_REASON_REQUIRED - Decline action requires that you specify a declineReason query parameter (at least 5 characters)
                                                        • CHECK_IN_NOT_REQUIRED - Reservation does not require check-in action
                                                        • ALREADY_CHECKED_IN - Reservation has already been checked in
                                                        • Parameters
                                                        • reservationId
                                                          string (required) 

                                                          UUID of the reservation

                                                          type
                                                          string (required) 

                                                          type of the action

                                                          Choices: cancel check_in approve decline teardown 

                                                          declineReason
                                                           (required) 

                                                          decline action description

                                                          POST
                                                          /reservations/action

                                                          Performs an action on multiple reservations. The same actions are supported as by POST /reservation/{reservationId}/action.

                                                          Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reservations/action

                                                          Access Level: User

                                                          Error Codes:

                                                          • RESERVATION_DECLINED - Reservation was declined and cannot be modified
                                                          • RESERVATION_FINISHED - Reservation has already finished and cannot be modified
                                                          • RESERVATION_FAILED - Reservation has failed and cannot be modified
                                                          • NOT_RESERVATION_OWNER - The current user cannot check in because the reservation was created by another user
                                                          • NOT_APPROVER - Because the current user is not the Approver for the reservation request, the current user cannot approve or decline the reservation
                                                          • NOT_CHECK_IN_TIME - Either you cannot yet check in to the reservation (N minutes before start) or check-in time has already expired
                                                          • APPROVAL_NOT_REQUIRED - Reservation does not require approval
                                                          • DECLINE_REASON_REQUIRED - Decline action requires that you specify a declineReason query parameter (at least 5 characters)
                                                          • CHECK_IN_NOT_REQUIRED - Reservation does not require check-in action
                                                          • ALREADY_CHECKED_IN - Reservation has already been checked in
                                                          • Parameters
                                                          • filter
                                                            string (required) 

                                                            filterable by the same set of options as GET /reservations

                                                            searchString
                                                            string (optional) 

                                                            if specified, only reservations whose names match the string are processed

                                                            startAfter
                                                            number (optional) 

                                                            timestamp of the beginning of custom period (if specified, only reservations that intersect with given period are processed)

                                                            endBefore
                                                            number (optional) 

                                                            timestamp of the ending of custom period (if specified, only reservations that intersect with given period are processed)

                                                            type
                                                            string (required) 

                                                            type of the action

                                                            Choices: cancel check_in approve decline teardown 

                                                            declineReason
                                                            string (optional) Example: This reservation does not conform to our company's standards

                                                            decline action description

                                                            POST
                                                            /conflicts

                                                            Returns list of conflicting devices and VLAN IDs for specified resources, VLAN IDs and for the specified time period

                                                            Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/conflicts

                                                            Access Level: User

                                                            Request Body:

                                                            JSON object with a subset of the following fields:

                                                            • topologyVersionId (string, optional) - UUID of the topology version (mandatory if devicesList is not specified)
                                                            • deviceList (list, optional) - list of resources UUID, describing devices to check (mandatory if topologyVersionId is not specified)
                                                            • vlanList (list, optional) - list of VLAN IDs, describing VLAN IDs to check
                                                            • customUtilizationList (list, optional) - list of resource utilization data objects. Each object contains the following fields:
                                                              • id (string, required) - UUID of resource
                                                              • isShared (boolean, required) - true when you want the resource to be in shared use, false when in exclusive use
                                                            • topologyReplacementsList (list, optional) - list of objects, describing topology resources replacements for conflict searching (meaningless when topologyVersionId is null, null by default). Each object contains the following fields:
                                                              • originalId (string, required) - UUID of current topology resource
                                                              • replacementId (string, required) - UUID of replacement resource
                                                            • startAfter (number, required) - timestamp of total time period start
                                                            • endBefore (number, required) - timestamp of total time period end
                                                            • duration (number, optional) - duration of recurring time period part in seconds (omitted by default, used when specified time period is recurring)
                                                            • recurrence (object, optional) - object describing recurrence of the specified time period (mandatory when duration is specified). Contains the following fields:
                                                              • type (string, required) - one of “HOURLY”, “DAILY”, “WEEKLY”, “MONTHLY”
                                                              • interval (number, optional) - per how many hours should time period repeat (meaningless for types other than “HOURLY”)
                                                              • daysOfWeek (list, optional) - on which days of week should time period repeat (list of strings, each can be one of “SUN”, “MON”, “TUE”, “WED”, “THU”, “FRI”, “SAT”; meaningless for types other than “WEEKLY”)
                                                            • excludeReservationId (string, optional) - UUID of the reservation excluded from conflicts checking (null by default)

                                                            Returns:

                                                            • conflictingResources (list) - list of conflicting resources (both devices and ports)
                                                              • inventoryId (string) - UUID of the resource
                                                              • inventoryParentId (string) - UUID of parent of the resource (null if resource has no parent)
                                                              • name (string) - name of the resource
                                                              • type (string) - either “DEVICE” or “PORT”
                                                              • alternativeResources (list) - list of “alternatives” - resources with the same template. Always empty for topology resources because they cannot be replaced.
                                                                • id (string) - UUID of the resource
                                                                • name (string) - name of the resource
                                                                • parentName (string) - name of the resource parent (null for devices)
                                                                • configurable (boolean) - true if resource interface is one of the following: “CONFIGURABLE”, “CONFIGURABLE_LAYER1_SWITCH”, “CONFIGURABLE_LAYER2_SWITCH”, false otherwise
                                                                • shared (boolean) - true if the device is shared, false if it is in exclusive use
                                                            • conflictingVlanIds (list) - list of conflicting VLAN IDs
                                                            • alternativeStartDates (list) - list of some alternative start dates for the same reservation data, but with no conflicts
                                                              • startDate (number) - timestamp
                                                            • alternativeStartDatesIgnoreVlans (list) - list of some alternative start dates for the same reservation data, but with no resource conflicts
                                                              • startDate (number) - timestamp
                                                            • alternativeStartDatesIgnoreResources (list) - list of some alternative start dates for the same reservation data, but with no vlan conflicts
                                                              • startDate (number) - timestamp
                                                            • resolutionSet (object) - a resolution set means that if all the reservations in list were canceled or re-scheduled, the requested reservation can be fulfilled.
                                                              • conflicts (list) - list of resolution set conflicts, each conflict include reservation and list of resources and VLANs which are involved in the conflict
                                                                • reservation (object) - basic reservation information
                                                                  • id (string) - UUID of the reservation
                                                                  • name (string) - name of the reservation
                                                                  • description (string) - reservation description
                                                                  • start (number) - timestamp when the reservation starts
                                                                  • end (number) - timestamp when the reservation ends for non-recurring reservations, timestamp when the reservation schedule ends for recurring reservation
                                                                  • duration (number) - duration of reservation in seconds for non-recurring reservations, for recurring duration of every reservation event
                                                                  • creatorId (string) - UUID of the creator of the reservation
                                                                  • created (number) - creation timestamp
                                                                  • lastModifierId (string) - UUID of the user who performed the last modification
                                                                  • lastModified (string) - last modification timestamp
                                                                • resourceIds (list) - list of conflicting with given reservation inventory resource IDs
                                                                  • id (string) - UUID of the inventory resource
                                                                • vlanIds (list) - list of conflicting with given reservation VLAN IDs

                                                            Error Codes:

                                                            • TOPOLOGY_NOT_FOUND - The specified topology was not found
                                                            • DEVICE_NOT_FOUND - The specified device does not exist in the inventory

                                                            GET
                                                            /escalation_requests

                                                            Returns list of escalation requests that accessible for current user. Administrators and escalation manager can see all requests, regular users can see only requests that they created.

                                                            Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/escalation_requests

                                                            Access Level: User

                                                            Returns:

                                                            • total (number) - total number of stored items
                                                            • offset (number) - offset of the current page
                                                            • count (number) - number of items on the page
                                                            • escalationRequests (list)
                                                              • id (string) - UUID of the escalation request
                                                              • name (string) - name of the escalation request
                                                              • description (string) - escalation request description
                                                              • status (string) - status of escalation request, one of the “PENDING”, “APPROVED”, “AUTO_RESOLVED”, “CANCELLED”, “DECLINED”, “EXPIRED”
                                                              • assigneeId (string) - ID of assignee of escalation request. User must be member of escalation managers group
                                                              • validUntil (number) - timestamp when escalation request should be expired
                                                              • approvedResolutionSetNumber (number) - for approved escalation request, number of resolution set that was selected for approve
                                                              • declineReason (string) - decline reason for declined escalation request
                                                              • creatorId (string) - UUID of the requester, creator of the escalation requests
                                                              • created (number) - creation timestamp
                                                              • lastModifierId (string) - UUID of the user that performed the last modification
                                                              • lastModified (number) - last modification timestamp

                                                            Tags:

                                                            • pageable
                                                            • filterable by id, name, description, status, assigneeId, creatorId, lastModifierId
                                                            • sortable by any field
                                                            • Parameters
                                                            • searchString
                                                              string (optional) 

                                                              if specified, only escalation requests whose name or description match the string are returned

                                                            GET
                                                            /escalation_request/{escalationRequestId}

                                                            Returns details of escalation request specified by escalationRequestId

                                                            Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/escalation_request/{escalationRequestId}

                                                            Access Level: User

                                                            Returns:

                                                            The same set of escalation request fields as returned by GET /escalation_requests as well as:

                                                            • resolutionSets (list) - list of resolution set. A resolution set means that if all the reservations in list were canceled or re-scheduled, the requested reservation can be fulfilled.
                                                              • number (number) - number of resolution set can be used for order resolution sets
                                                              • pendingReservation (object) - basic information of pending reservation for given escalation request
                                                                • id (string) - UUID of the reservation
                                                                • name (string) - name of the reservation
                                                                • description (string) - reservation description
                                                                • start (number) - timestamp when the reservation starts
                                                                • end (number) - timestamp when the reservation ends for non-recurring reservations, timestamp when the reservation schedule ends for recurring reservation
                                                                • duration (number) - duration of reservation in seconds for non-recurring reservations, for recurring duration of every reservation event
                                                                • creatorId (string) - UUID of the creator of the reservation
                                                                • created (number) - creation timestamp
                                                                • lastModifierId (string) - UUID of the user who performed the last modification
                                                                • lastModified (string) - last modification timestamp
                                                              • conflicts (list) - list of resolution set conflicts, each conflict include reservation and list of resources and VLANs which are involved in the conflict
                                                                • reservation (object) - basic conflicting reservation information
                                                                  • id (string) - UUID of the reservation
                                                                  • name (string) - name of the reservation
                                                                  • description (string) - reservation description
                                                                  • start (number) - timestamp when the reservation starts
                                                                  • end (number) - timestamp when the reservation ends for non-recurring reservations, timestamp when the reservation schedule ends for recurring reservation
                                                                  • duration (number) - duration of reservation in seconds for non-recurring reservations, for recurring duration of every reservation event
                                                                  • creatorId (string) - UUID of the creator of the reservation
                                                                  • created (number) - creation timestamp
                                                                  • lastModifierId (string) - UUID of the user who performed the last modification
                                                                  • lastModified (string) - last modification timestamp
                                                                • resources (list) - list of conflicting with given reservation inventory resources
                                                                  • id (string) - UUID of the resource
                                                                  • name (string) - name of the resource
                                                                  • parentId (string) - UUID of the parent resource
                                                                  • parentName (string) - name of the parent resource
                                                                  • type (string) - type of the resource (“DEVICE” or “PORT”)
                                                                  • isAccessible (boolean) - is resource accessible for current user
                                                                • vlanIds (list) - list of conflicting with given reservation VLAN IDs

                                                            Error Codes:

                                                            • ESCALATION_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND - The escalation request was not found

                                                            POST
                                                            /escalation_request/{escalationRequestId}/action

                                                            Performs an action on escalation request specified by escalationRequestId

                                                            Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/escalation_request/{escalationRequestId}

                                                            Access Level: User

                                                            Request Body:

                                                            • type (string, required) - action type one of “APPROVE”, “DECLINE”, “CANCEL”. To perform approve or decline user must be a member of escalation managers group. To perform cancel user must be creator of escalation request or admin.
                                                            • resolutionSetNumber (number, optional) - mandatory for approve action, number of resolution set that selected to resolve conflicts.
                                                            • reason (string, optional) - mandatory for decline action, reason of decline

                                                            Error Codes:

                                                            • ESCALATION_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND - The escalation request was not found
                                                            • ESCALATION_REQUEST_NOT_EDITABLE - when trying to perform action on historical escalation request with other when PENDING status
                                                            • ESCALATION_MANAGER_REQUIRED - when user that try to approve or decline escalation request is not a member of escalation managers user group
                                                            • RESOLUTION_SET_NOT_FOUND - when there is no resolution set with given number in escalation request
                                                            • Parameters
                                                            • escalationRequestId
                                                              string (required) 

                                                              UUID of the escalation request

                                                            • RequestToggle
                                                            • Body
                                                                  {
      "type": "APPROVE",
      "resolutionSetNumber": 1
    }
                                                            • Response  200
                                                            PUT
                                                            /escalation_request/{escalationRequestId}/assignee

                                                            Updates escalation request assignee. The assignee can be updated for escalation request with PENDING status only.

                                                            Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/escalation_request/{escalationRequestId}/assignee

                                                            Access Level: User

                                                            Error Codes:

                                                            • ESCALATION_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND - the escalation request was not found
                                                            • ESCALATION_REQUEST_NOT_EDITABLE - when trying to perform action on historical escalation request with other when PENDING status
                                                            • ESCALATION_MANAGER_REQUIRED - when new assignee user is not a member of escalation managers user group
                                                            • ESCALATION_REQUEST_REASSIGN_NOT_ALLOWED - when user that try to assign escalation request is not requester or current assignee
                                                            • Parameters
                                                            • escalationRequestId
                                                              string (required) 

                                                              UUID of the escalation request

                                                              assigneeId
                                                              string (required) 

                                                              UUID of new escalation request assignee

                                                            • Response  200
                                                            POST
                                                            /property_queries

                                                            Resolves all provided property queries

                                                            Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/property_queries

                                                            Access Level: User

                                                            Request Body: JSON object with any subset of the following fields:

                                                            • queries (array, required) - an array of property queries. For each item:
                                                              • key (string) - a key of a property query;
                                                              • query (string) - a text which contains property queries inside placeholders.
                                                            • reservationId (string, optional) - UUID of a reservation which should be used during resolving property queries.
                                                            • topologyId (string, optional) - UUID of a topology which should be used during resolving property queries.

                                                            Returns:

                                                            • results (array) - an array of resolved values of property queries. For each item:
                                                              • key (string) - a key of a property query;
                                                              • result (string) - a resolved value of a property query.

                                                            Error Codes:

                                                            • BAD_PROPERTY_QUERY_FORMAT - incorrect format of a property query.
                                                            • RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND - a reservation cannot be found.
                                                            • TOPOLOGY_NOT_FOUND - a topology cannot be found.
                                                            • RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND - a resource cannot be found.
                                                            • PORT_NOT_FOUND - a port cannot be found.
                                                            • PROPERTY_NOT_FOUND - a property cannot be found.

                                                            Property Query Syntax

                                                            A placeholder is used in a text for substituting a value of a resolved property query:

                                                            ${property_query}

                                                            Structure of a property query:

                                                            <LOCATION>/resources/<RESOURCE_NAME>/[PORT_NAME/]<PROPERTY_NAME>

                                                            Where parameters are following:

                                                            • LOCATION - a data origin, available options:
                                                              • inventory;
                                                              • topology.
                                                            • RESOURCE_NAME - a name of a resource;
                                                            • PORT_NAME - optional, a name of resource port;
                                                            • PROPERTY_NAME - a name of a property.

                                                            Escape character ‘\’:

                                                            • Special characters (slash ‘/‘) can be escaped by a backslash ‘\’. For example, “A/B” is escaped to “A\/B”.
                                                            • For using a backslash ‘\’ character it must be escaped as well. For example, “A\B” is escaped to “A\B”.

                                                            Examples:

                                                            ${inventory/resources/Server #1/ipAddress}
${inventory/resources/Cisco Switch/Fa0\/1/Port Speed}
${topology/resources/My Virtual Machine/OS Family}
                                                            • Request  JSON objectToggle
                                                            • Body
                                                                 {
     "reservationId": "3080c247-a351-4171-a0e7-05df813f68ec",
     "queries": [
       {
         "key": "parameter 1",
         "query": "${inventory/resources/Server #1/ipAddress}"
       },
       {
         "key": "parameter 2",
         "query": "value 2"
       }
     ]
   }
                                                            • Response  200Toggle
                                                            • Headers
                                                              Content-Type: application/json
                                                              Body
                                                                 {
     "results": [
       {
         "key": "parameter 1",
         "result": "192.168.1.1"
       },
       {
         "key": "parameter 2",
         "result": "value 2"
       }
     ]
   }
