                                                            • name (string) - name of the form
                                                            • fieldGroups (list) - list of field groups with the following attributes:
                                                            • id (string) - UUID of the field group
                                                            • name (string) - name of the field group
                                                            • fields (list) - list of objects representing form fields:
                                                              • id (string) - UUID of the field
                                                              • name (string) - name of the field
                                                              • description (string) - field description
                                                              • isRequired (boolean) - true when value for the field must always be specified (i.e. null is invalid value)
                                                              • type (string) - field type (one of “TEXT”, “TEXT_AREA”, “BOOLEAN”, “DECIMAL”, “INTEGER”, “ATTACHMENT”, “PASSWORD”, “DROP_DOWN_LIST”)
                                                              • defaultValue (string) - default value for the field (can be null, meaning no value, always null for type: “PASSWORD”)
                                                              • availableValues (list) - used only for “DROP_DOWN_LIST” type, list of available values
                                                            • Parameters

                                                            POST
                                                            /request_form

                                                            Creates new request form

                                                            Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/request_form

                                                            Access Level: Admin

                                                            Request Body:

                                                            JSON object with the following fields:

                                                            • name (string, required) - name of the request form
                                                            • fieldGroups (list, required) - list of objects with the following fields (must contain at least 1 item):
                                                              • name (string, required) - name of the field group
                                                              • fields (list, required) - list of objects representing form fields (must contain at least 1 item):
                                                                • name (string, required) - name of the field
                                                                • description (string, optional) - field description (“” by default)
                                                                • isRequired (boolean, optional) - true when value for the field must always be specified, i.e. null is invalid value (false by default)
                                                                • type (string, optional) - field type (one of “TEXT”, “TEXT_AREA”, “BOOLEAN”, “DECIMAL”, “INTEGER”, “ATTACHMENT”, “PASSWORD”, “DROP_DOWN_LIST”; “TEXT” by default)
                                                                • defaultValue (string, optional) - default value for the field (null by default)
                                                                • availableValues (list, optional) - used only for “DROP_DOWN_LIST” type, list of available values

                                                            Returns:

                                                            Newly created request form, the same as if returned by GET /request_form/{formId}

                                                            Error Codes:

                                                            • INVALID_VALUE_TYPE - Request form includes invalid values (for example, expected number but got string)
                                                            • NAME_NOT_UNIQUE - Request form name is already in use
                                                            • REQUEST_FORM_EMPTY - Request form does not contain any fields
                                                            • PROPERTY_BAD_ENUM_VALUE - The default value attribute of field of type “DROP_DOWN_LIST” has a value that is not included in the availableValues list
                                                            • RequestToggle

                                                            Returns:

                                                            Error Codes:

                                                            • REQUEST_FORM_NOT_FOUND - The specified request form was not found
                                                            • INVALID_VALUE_TYPE - Request form includes invalid values (for example, expected number but got string )

                                                              replaceFields
                                                              boolean (optional) Default: false 

                                                              when true, request form fields are fully replaced with the passed data, e.g., if an existing field is not presented in the request, that field will be removed.

                                                            DELETE

                                                              DELETE
                                                              /request_form/{formId}/field_group/{fieldGroupId}

                                                              Deletes field group specified by fieldGroupId in the request form specified by formId. All nested fields are also deleted.

                                                              Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/request_form/{formId}/field_group/{fieldGroupId}

                                                              Access Level: Admin

                                                              Error Codes:

                                                              • FIELD_GROUP_NOT_FOUND - the specified field group was not found
                                                              • Parameters
                                                              • formId
                                                                string (required) 

                                                                UUID of the request form

                                                                fieldGroupId
                                                                string (required) 

                                                                UUID of the field group to delete

                                                                DELETE
                                                                /request_form/{formId}/field_group/{fieldGroupId}/field/{fieldId}

                                                                Deletes field specified by fieldId from the group specified by fieldGroupId in the request form specified by formId

                                                                Access Level: Admin

                                                                  fieldId
                                                                  string (required)

                                                                  GET
                                                                  /reports

                                                                  Lists report data

                                                                  Full URL: /velocity/api/reservation/v6/reports

                                                                  Access Level: User

                                                                  Returns:

                                                                  JSON object with the following fields:

                                                                  • device (object) - the device associated with the report item (will be null if reportType is not “DEVICE” or “PORT”)
                                                                    • id (string) - UUID of the device
                                                                    • name (string) - name of the device
                                                                  • port (object) - the port associated with the report item (will be null if reportType is not “PORT”)
                                                                    • id (string) - UUID of the port
                                                                    • name (string) - name of the port
                                                                  • template (object) - the template associated with the report item (will be null if reportType is not “TEMPLATE”)
                                                                    • id (string) - UUID of the template
                                                                    • name (string) - name of the template
                                                                  • user (object) - the user associated with the report item (will be null if reportType is not “USER” or “TECHNICIAN”)
                                                                    • id (string) - UUID of the user
                                                                    • name (string) - name of the user
                                                                  • utilization (object) - the resources utilization statistics for the past and the future. The statistics for the past will be null if periodType is “FUTURE”. The statistics for the future will be null if periodType is “PAST”
                                                                    • lastDay (number) - statistics for the last day
                                                                    • lastWeek (number) - statistics for the last week
                                                                    • lastMonth (number) - statistics for the last month
                                                                    • last3Months (number) - statistics for the last 3 months
                                                                    • last6Months (number) - statistics for the last 6 months
                                                                    • lastYear (number) - statistics for the last year
                                                                    • nextDay (number) - statistics for the next day
                                                                    • nextWeek (number) - statistics for the next week
                                                                    • nextMonth (number) - statistics for the next month
                                                                    • next3Months (number) - statistics for the next 3 months
                                                                    • next6Months (number) - statistics for the next 6 months
                                                                    • nextYear (number) - statistics for the next year
                                                                    • period (number) - statistics for the custom period specified by startAfter and endBefore
                                                                  • conflicts (object) - the resource conflicts statistics for the past. The statistics will be null if periodType is “FUTURE”.
                                                                    • lastDay (number) - statistics for the last day
                                                                    • lastWeek (number) - statistics for the last week
                                                                    • lastMonth (number) - statistics for the last month
                                                                    • last3Months (number) - statistics for the last 3 months
                                                                    • last6Months (number) - statistics for the last 6 months
                                                                    • lastYear (number) - statistics for the last year
                                                                    • period (number) - statistics for the custom period specified by startAfter and endBefore
                                                                  • techniciansProductivity (object) - the technicians productivity statistics for the period (will be null if reportType is not “TECHNICIAN”)
                                                                    • completedWorkOrders (number) - number of completed work orders
                                                                    • averageTimeToComplete (number) - average time to complete work order is seconds (will be null if there are no completed work orders for this technician)
                                                                    • openWorkOrders (number) - number of open work orders
                                                                    • failedWorkOrders (number) - number of failed work orders
                                                                    • declinedWorkOrders (number) - number of declined work orders

                                                                  Tags:

                                                                  • pageable
                                                                  • sortable by any field deviceId, deviceName, portId, portName, templateId, templateName, userId, userName, utilizationLastDay … utilizationPeriod**, conflictsLastDay … conflictsPeriod, completedWorkOrders, averageTimeToComplete, openWorkOrders, failedWorkOrders, *declinedWorkOrders
                                                                  • Parameters
                                                                  • reportType
                                                                    string (optional) Default: DEVICE 

                                                                    report type

                                                                    Choices: DEVICE PORT TEMPLATE USER TECHNICIAN 

                                                                    periodType
                                                                    string (optional) Default: ALL 

                                                                    period type

                                                                    Choices: ALL PAST FUTURE 

                                                                    measure
                                                                    string (optional) Default: TOTAL_COUNT 

                                                                    report measure. taken into account only when reportType is “USER”.

                                                                    Choices: TOTAL_HOURS REQUIRED_CHECK_IN_HOURS CHECKED_IN_HOURS_RATIO TOTAL_COUNT REQUIRED_CHECK_IN_COUNT CHECKED_IN_COUNT_RATIO 

                                                                    userGroupId
                                                                    string (optional) 

                                                                    user group UUID to fetch reports for. “UNGROUPED” means ungrouped users, omit for all users. . taken into account only when reportType is “USER” or “TECHNICIAN”.

                                                                    startAfter
                                                                    number (optional) 

                                                                    timestamp of the beginning of custom period (optional)

                                                                    endBefore
                                                                    number (optional) Default: now 

                                                                    timestamp of the ending of custom period (default - current time)

                                                                    searchString
                                                                    string (optional) 

                                                                    if specified, only devices/ports/templates whose name, description or properties match the string are returned

                                                                  • Response  200Toggle

                                                                  Message Service v5

                                                                  Access Level: User

                                                                  Returns: (boolean)

                                                                  true if there are new messages

                                                                  Tags:

                                                                  • Body

                                                                  GET
                                                                  /messages

                                                                  Returns all messages for the current user

                                                                  Full URL: /velocity/api/message/v5/messages

                                                                  Access Level: User

                                                                  Returns:

                                                                  List of messages with the following fields:

                                                                  • id (string) - UUID of the message
                                                                  • senderId (string) - UUID of the sender
                                                                  • subject (string) - message subject
                                                                  • origin (string) - message origin - optional string supplied by the sender to identify where the message came from. Useful for automated scripts.
                                                                  • type (string) - message content type. Currently can be only “HTML”.
                                                                  • message (string) - message content (application URL is replaced with ${baseUrl})
                                                                  • created (number) - date when the message was sent
                                                                  • readTime (number) - date when the message was read (null if unread)
                                                                  • isRead (boolean) - true if the message was read

                                                                  Tags:

                                                                  • pageable

                                                                  POST
                                                                  /message

                                                                  Sends a new message to a user, to a certain user group or to all users.

                                                                  Full URL: /velocity/api/message/v5/message

                                                                  Access Level: User

                                                                  Request Body:

                                                                  JSON object with the following fields:

                                                                  • subject (string, optional) - message subject
                                                                  • message (string, required) - message content
                                                                  • origin (string, optional) - message origin
                                                                  • userId (string, optional) - UUID of the user that should receive the message
                                                                  • userGroupId (string, optional) - UUID of the user group that should receive the message (null to send to all users; null by default)
                                                                  • selfCopy (boolean, optional) - true to send copy to sender (false by default)

                                                                  If userId is specified, then userGroupId is ignored and a message will be send to the specified user. Otherwise userGroupId is processed as described above.

                                                                  Error Codes:

                                                                  • USER_NOT_FOUND - the specified user was not found
                                                                  • RequestToggle
                                                                  • Body
                                                                    {
  "message": "This is a test message.",
  "userGroupId": null,
  "selfCopy": true
}

                                                                  PUT
                                                                  /message/{messageId}

                                                                  Updates the message specified by messageId.

                                                                  Full URL: /velocity/api/message/v5/message/{messageId}

                                                                  Access Level: User

                                                                  JSON object with the following fields:

                                                                  • isRead (boolean, required) - true to mark the message as read. Does nothing if the message was already read. Cannot be changed from true to false.

                                                                  Returns:

                                                                  Newly updated message, the same as if returned by GET /message/{messageId}

                                                                  Error Codes:

                                                                  • MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND - message with specified ID was not found

                                                                      GET
                                                                      /profile/{profileId}

                                                                      Returns details of the user specified by profileId

                                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/user/v6/profile/{profileId}

                                                                      Access Level: User

                                                                      Returns:

                                                                      • id (string) - UUID of the user
                                                                      • name (string) - full user name
                                                                      • login (string) - user login
                                                                      • description (string) - user description
                                                                      • autosetTimeZone (boolean) - true if time zone should be set automatically
                                                                      • timeZoneId (string) - time zone identifier (can be null)
                                                                      • timeZoneOffset (number) - time zone offset from UTC-0 in milliseconds
                                                                      • role (string) - user role (one of “SUPER_ADMIN”, “ADMIN”, “USER”)
                                                                      • homePage (string) - user home page represented as relative part of URL.
                                                                      • email (string) - user e-mail address
                                                                      • receivesEmailNotifications (boolean) - true if the user receives e-mail notifications
                                                                      • prefersExternalApplicationToHandleConsoleUrls (boolean) - if true, SSH/Telnet URLs will not be converted to Velocity Terminal URLs
                                                                      • receivesDailyReports (boolean) - if true, the user receives a daily report that identifies inventory resources that are not connected or expected to be available.
                                                                      • receivesOwnReservationInvitations (boolean) - if true, the user receives a reservation invitation via email.
                                                                      • isDisabled (boolean) - true if the user is disabled
                                                                      • userStatus (string) - null if the activity tracking is disabled; Other valid values can be (“ACTIVE”,”IDLE” and “NO_ACTIVITY_LAST_MONTH “)
                                                                      • autoApproveFrom (list) - list of users to auto-approve requests from (makes sense only if the user is marked as approver in some user group)
                                                                        • id - UUID of a user
                                                                      • groups (list) - list of user groups
                                                                        • id - UUID of a user group
                                                                      • created (number) - timestamp when the user was created
                                                                      • lastModifierId (string) - UUID of the user who performed the last modification of the profile (can be null)
                                                                      • lastModified (number) - last modification timestamp (can be null)

                                                                      Error Codes:

                                                                      • PROFILE_NOT_FOUND - profile with specified ID does not exist

                                                                      PUT
                                                                      /profile/{profileId}

                                                                      Updates the profile specified by profileId

                                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/user/v6/profile/{profileId}

                                                                      Access Level: User

                                                                      Request Body:

                                                                      JSON object containing a subset of the following fields:

                                                                      • name (string, optional) - full user name
                                                                      • description (string, optional) - user description
                                                                      • autosetTimeZone (boolean, optional) - true if time zone should be set automatically
                                                                      • timeZoneId (string, optional) - time zone identifier (null by default)
                                                                      • role (string, optional) - user role (one of “ADMIN”, “USER”)
                                                                      • homePage (string) - user home page represented as relative part of URL.
                                                                      • email (string, optional) - user e-mail address
                                                                      • receivesEmailNotifications (boolean, optional) - true if the user receives e-mail notifications
                                                                      • prefersExternalApplicationToHandleConsoleUrls (boolean, optional) - if true, SSH/Telnet URLs will not be converted to Velocity Terminal URLs
                                                                      • receivesDailyReports (boolean, optional) - if true, the user receives a daily report that identifies inventory resources that are not connected or expected to be available. This option is for admin-users only, and it is ignored for others (always false).
                                                                      • receivesOwnReservationInvitations (boolean, optional) - if true, the user receives a reservation invitation via email.
                                                                      • isDisabled (boolean, optional) - true if the user is disabled
                                                                      • autoApproveFrom (list) - list of users to auto-approve requests from (makes sense only if the user is marked as approver in some user group)
                                                                        • id - UUID of a user
                                                                      • groups (list) - list of user groups
                                                                        • id - UUID of a user group

                                                                      Returns:

                                                                      Updated user profile represented the same way as returned by GET /profile/{profileId}

                                                                      Error Codes:

                                                                      • PROFILE_NOT_FOUND - user profile with specified ID does not exist
                                                                      • CANNOT_APPLY_ROLE - specified role cannot be applied
                                                                      • CANNOT_MODIFY_SYSTEM_USER - the system user cannot be modified
                                                                      • Parameters
                                                                      • profileId
                                                                        string (required) 

                                                                        UUID of the profile to update

                                                                      GET
                                                                      /group/{groupId}

                                                                      Returns user group specified by groupId

                                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/user/v6/group/{groupId}

                                                                      Access Level: User

                                                                      Returns:

                                                                      • id (string) - UUID of the group (null for the group representing Ungrouped users)
                                                                      • name (string) - name of the group (“Ungrouped” for the group representing Ungrouped users)
                                                                      • userCount (number) - number of users in the group
                                                                      • weeklyQuota (number) - weekly reservation time quota in hours (null if it is not set)
                                                                      • monthlyQuota (number) - monthly reservation time quota in hours (null if it is not set)
                                                                      • quarterlyQuota (number) - quarterly reservation time quota in hours (null if it is not set)
                                                                      • yearlyQuota (number) - yearly reservation time quota in hours (null if it is not set)
                                                                      • isCheckinRequired (boolean) - true if users in the group have to check in reservations
                                                                      • approvers (list) - list of approvers assigned to the group (empty if the group does not require approval)
                                                                        • id - UUID of the approver
                                                                        • name - name of the approver
                                                                      • users (list) - list of users that belong to the group (includes only if parameter includeUsers is true)
                                                                        • id - UUID of the user
                                                                        • name - name of the user
                                                                      • technicianManagerId (string) - UUID of technician manager of the group (null if group is not a technicians group)
                                                                      • isEscalationManagers (boolean) - true if users in the group are escalation managers
                                                                      • hasTopologiesMaintenanceAccess (boolean) - true if users in the group can create, copy, edit and remove topologies.
                                                                      • requestFormId (string) - UUID of a reservation request form associated within the group (null if it is not set)
                                                                      • creatorId (string) - UUID of the owner
                                                                      • created (number) - creation timestamp
                                                                      • deviceGroupCount (number) - number of device groups associated with the user group (includes only if parameter includeDeviceGroupCount is true)

                                                                      Error Codes:

                                                                      • USER_GROUP_NOT_FOUND - The user group was not found
                                                                      • Parameters
                                                                      • groupId
                                                                        string (required) 

                                                                        UUID of the group to retrieve (“NONE” for ungrouped users)

                                                                        includeUsers
                                                                        boolean (optional) 

                                                                        If true, list of users in the group is included in the response.

                                                                        includeDeviceGroupCount
                                                                        boolean (optional) 

                                                                        If true, count of device groups associated with the user group is included in the response.

                                                                      POST
                                                                      /group

                                                                      Creates new user group

                                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/user/v6/group

                                                                      Access Level: Admin

                                                                      Request Body:

                                                                      JSON object with the following fields:

                                                                      • name (string, required) - user group name
                                                                      • weeklyQuota (number) - weekly reservation time quota in hours (specify 0 or null for unlimited reservation time)
                                                                      • monthlyQuota (number) - monthly reservation time quota in hours (specify 0 or null for unlimited reservation time)
                                                                      • quarterlyQuota (number) - quarterly reservation time quota in hours (specify 0 or null for unlimited reservation time)
                                                                      • yearlyQuota (number) - yearly reservation time quota in hours (specify 0 or null for unlimited reservation time)
                                                                      • isCheckinRequired (boolean) - true if users in the group have to check in reservations
                                                                      • users (list) - list of users associated with the group (empty if the group doesn’t have associated users)
                                                                      • approvers (list) - list of approvers assigned to the group (empty if the group does not require approval)
                                                                      • technicianManagerId (string) - UUID of technician manager of the group (null if group is not a technicians group)
                                                                      • isEscalationManagers (boolean) - true if users in the group are escalation managers
                                                                      • hasTopologiesMaintenanceAccess (boolean) - true if users in the group can create, copy, edit and remove topologies.
                                                                      • requestFormId (string) - UUID of a reservation request form associated within the group (null if it is not set)

                                                                      Returns:

                                                                      Newly created user group, the same as if returned by GET /group/{groupId}

                                                                      Error Codes:

                                                                      • NAME_NOT_UNIQUE - user group with that name already exists
                                                                      • INVALID_RESERVATION_TIME_QUOTA - invalid value for a reservation time quota (see the message for details)
                                                                      • TECHNICIAN_MANAGER_NOT_FOUND - the specified technician manager was not found
                                                                      • TECHNICIAN_MANAGER_DISABLED - the specified technician manager is disabled
                                                                      • RequestToggle
                                                                      • Body
                                                                            {
      "name": "My group",
      "weeklyQuota": 7,
      "monthlyQuota": 30,
      "quarterlyQuota": null,
      "yearlyQuota": null,
      "isCheckinRequired": true,

                                                                            Asset Service v3 

                                                                            Asset Service provides ability to manage assets. Asset is data associated with certain media type (e.g. “application/xml”) and an optional name. You will usually use assets to store files, and then refer to them from other services (e.g. driver packages, icons, configuration and firmware files in Inventory Service).

                                                                            Previously, this service was called “Repository Service” and was also used to manage test cases. However, this functionality is currently present in new Repository Service v0. You must use Repository Service to perform operations with itars, test cases, and parameter files.

                                                                            Notice that the endpoints in this service start with /velocity/api/repository.

                                                                            GET
                                                                            /assets

                                                                            Returns information about assets.

                                                                            Full URL: /velocity/api/repository/v3/assets

                                                                            Access Level: User

                                                                            Returns:

                                                                            JSON object with the following fields:

                                                                            • assets (list) - list of assets with the following fields:
                                                                            • id (string) - UUID of the asset
                                                                            • name (string) - name of the asset
                                                                            • contentType (string) - content type of the asset
                                                                            • contentSize (number) - content size of the asset in bytes
                                                                            • Parameters
                                                                            • assetId
                                                                              string (required) 

                                                                              UUID of the asset. Provide this parameter multiple times to get information about multiple assets.

                                                                            • Response  200Toggle
                                                                            • Body

                                                                            GET
                                                                            /asset/{assetId}

                                                                            Returns asset specified by assetId. This request does NOT require authentication, if the asset is not a test case asset.

                                                                            Full URL: /velocity/api/repository/v3/asset/{assetId}

                                                                            Access Level: None

                                                                            Returns:

                                                                            Asset data

                                                                            Tags:

                                                                            • cacheable-public

                                                                            Error Codes:

                                                                            • ASSET_NOT_FOUND - the specified asset was not found
                                                                            • BAD_ICON - The icon cannot be rasterized
                                                                            • Parameters
                                                                            • assetId
                                                                              string (required) 

                                                                              UUID of the asset

                                                                              asFile
                                                                              boolean (optional) 

                                                                              when true, if asset has filename then adds it to Content-Disposition header of response

                                                                              rasterizedIconSize
                                                                              number (optional) 

                                                                              if specified, assets with content type “image/svg+xml” or “image/svg” will be rasterized to PNG format. Assets of with other content types are returned unchanged disregarding the parameter. Value of the parameter is preferred width (and height, since icons are rectangular) of the icon.

                                                                              Choices: 16 24 32 48 64 

                                                                              POST
                                                                              /asset

                                                                              Creates a new asset. It’s mandatory to provide Content-Type header. If Content-Disposition header is provided, an asset name will be set as the corresponding value of its filename parameter.

                                                                              A request with multipart/form-data content type is handled as well. In this case, the first part is treated as a new asset data, and the part should satisfy the requirements described above.

                                                                              Full URL: /velocity/api/repository/v3/asset

                                                                              Access Level: User

                                                                              Request Body: Asset data

                                                                              Returns:

                                                                              JSON object with the same set of fields as returned by GET /assets.

                                                                              Error Codes:

                                                                              • CONTENT_TYPE_EXPECTED - Content-Type header was not specified
                                                                              • MAX_SIZE_EXCEEDED - request body size too big - exceeds 16 MB
                                                                              • RequestToggle
                                                                              • Headers
                                                                                Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="assetData.bin"
                                                                              • Response  200Toggle
                                                                              • Body
                                                                                    {
      "id": "9a22a225-7222-420a-8318-999083eb2c24",
      "name": "assetData.bin",
      "contentType": "application/octet-stream",
      "contentSize": 9
    }
                                                                              DELETE
                                                                              /asset/{assetId}

                                                                              Deletes the asset specified by assetId

                                                                              Full URL: /velocity/api/repository/v3/asset/{assetId}

                                                                              Access Level: Admin

                                                                              Error Codes:

                                                                              • ASSET_NOT_FOUND - the specified asset was not found

                                                                              • Parameters

                                                                                string (required) 

                                                                                UUID of the asset to delete

                                                                                Auth Service v2 

                                                                                Auth Service allows to retrieve authentication token.

                                                                                GET
                                                                                /token

                                                                                Returns token that can be used later for authentication. The lifetime for returned token equals to duration parameter. The default lifetime is the same as idle time to release license. See timeoutPeriodToReleaseLicenseMinutes in GET /settings method.

                                                                                Full URL: /velocity/api/auth/v2/token

                                                                                Access Level: User

                                                                                Returns:

                                                                                • token (string) - token that can be used for authentication
                                                                                • expirationDate (number) - token expiration date timestamp

                                                                                Error Codes:

                                                                                • TOKEN_DURATION_OUT_OF_RANGE - if duration parameter not in range [10, 7*24*60]
                                                                                • Parameters
                                                                                • duration
                                                                                  number (optional) 

                                                                                  lifetime of the token in minutes.

                                                                                • Response  200Toggle

    }

                                                                                  Settings Service v5 

                                                                                  Settings Service manages application settings

                                                                                  GET
                                                                                  /settings

                                                                                  Returns application settings

                                                                                  Full URL: /velocity/api/settings/v5/settings

                                                                                  Access Level: User

                                                                                  Returns:

                                                                                  • isConflictingReservationAllowed (boolean) - is allowed to create a new future reservations, which have conflicts with already existing reservations
                                                                                  • isUtilizationByUserAllowed (boolean) - is allowed utilization by user reports and the reservation check-in feature
                                                                                  • checkInPeriodMinutes (number) - time to check in after reservation starts (minutes)
                                                                                  • checkInNotificationMinutes (number) - time before reservation starts to notify user to check in (minutes)
                                                                                  • isPerUserReportingEnabled (boolean) - is per user reporting currently enabled
                                                                                  • dailyHealthReportHourOfDay (number) - hour of day when the Daily Inventory Status report is generated
                                                                                  • isUserActivityTrackingEnabled (boolean) - is user activity tracking currently enabled
                                                                                  • idleStatusLimitMinutes (number) - indicates the time of inactivity before Users are defined as “Idle” (minutes)
                                                                                  • isConcreteTechnicianAssignmentAllowed (boolean) - determines if users are allowed to assign a particular lab technician when requesting a reservation
                                                                                  • hoursForProcessingWorkOrder (number) - indicates the time allowed for lab technicians to respond to the work orders (hours)
                                                                                  • inventoryWorkOrderTechnicianGroupId (string) - UUID of the user group assigned to perform inventory work orders
                                                                                  • topologyConnectionTypes (list) - list of available topology connection types.
                                                                                  • id (string) - UUID of the connection type
                                                                                  • name (string) - name of the connection type
                                                                                  • shortcut (string) - short name of the connection type
                                                                                  • kind (string) - kind of the connection type, one of “L1”, “L2”, “VIRTUAL”
                                                                                  • isBuiltin (boolean) - true if connection type is built-in, false if connection type is user defined
                                                                                  • intervalToRunEndMandatoryTask (number) - execution offset in seconds from the end of a reservation for mandatory teardown tasks that should run near end of reservation
                                                                                  • mandatoryAutomationTasks (list) - list of mandatory startup and teardown automation tasks
                                                                                  • id (string) - UUID of the task
                                                                                  • name (string) - name of the test case
                                                                                  • type (string) - task type, one of “MANDATORY_AT_START” or “MANDATORY_NEAR_END”
                                                                                  • testCaseId (string) - test case UUID
                                                                                  • parameters (list) - parameters of the test case
                                                                                    • name (string) - name of the parameter
                                                                                    • value (string) - value of the parameter
                                                                                    • description (string) - description of the parameter
                                                                                  • tokenForMaintenance (string) - token for maintenance (available for admin users only, null otherwise)
                                                                                  • timeoutPeriodToReleaseLicenseMinutes (number) - timeout period, after which application have the ability to release the license from user if somebody else can not login
                                                                                  • enforceAutoLogoutAfterIdleTime (boolean) - enforce auto-logout independent of available licenses if true
                                                                                  • triggeredAutomationTasks (list) - list of triggered automation tasks with specified events which would trigger tasks execution
                                                                                  • id (string) - UUID of the task
                                                                                  • eventType (string) - type of event which will trigger task execution, one of specified in triggeredEventTypeList
                                                                                  • testCaseId (string) - test case UUID
                                                                                  • parameters (list) - parameters of the test case
                                                                                    • name (string) - name of the parameter
                                                                                    • value (string) - value of the parameter
                                                                                    • description (string) - description of the parameter
                                                                                  • triggeredEventTypeList (list) - list of event types, which could trigger automation tasks execution
                                                                                  • id (string) - enum constant id of the event type
                                                                                  • interval (number) - exists only for “ON_RESERVATION_APPROACHING_END”, defines time interval before reservation ends in seconds, when assigned tasks should be triggered
                                                                                  • definedParameters (array) - names of parameters which would be provided by server to every test case assigned to the event type
                                                                                  • allowReservationsFromInventory (boolean) - if this flag is true then users are able to reserve individual pieces of equipment from the Inventory page
                                                                                  • Response  200Toggle
                                                                                  • Body

                                                                                  PUT
                                                                                  /settings

                                                                                  Updates application settings

                                                                                  Full URL: /velocity/api/settings/v5/settings

                                                                                  Access Level: Admin

                                                                                  Request Body:

                                                                                  JSON object containing the following fields:

                                                                                  • isConflictingReservationAllowed (boolean) - is allowed to create a new future reservations, which have conflicts with already existing reservations
                                                                                  • isUtilizationByUserAllowed (boolean) - is allowed utilization by user reports and the reservation check-in feature
                                                                                  • checkInPeriodMinutes (number) - time to check in after reservation starts (minutes)
                                                                                  • checkInNotificationMinutes (number) - time before reservation starts to notify user to check in (minutes)
                                                                                  • isPerUserReportingEnabled (boolean) - is per user reporting currently enabled
                                                                                  • dailyHealthReportHourOfDay (number) - hour of day when the Daily Inventory Status report is generated, value should be between 0 and 23, otherwise returns error with error code INVALID_APPLICATION_SETTING_VALUE
                                                                                  • isUserActivityTrackingEnabled (boolean) - is user activity tracking currently enabled
                                                                                  • idleStatusLimitMinutes (number) - indicates the time of inactivity before Users are defined as “Idle” (minutes)
                                                                                  • isConcreteTechnicianAssignmentAllowed (boolean) - determines if users are allowed to assign a particular lab technician when requesting a reservation
                                                                                  • hoursForProcessingWorkOrder (number) - indicates the time allowed for lab technicians to respond to the work orders (hours)
                                                                                  • inventoryWorkOrderTechnicianGroupId (string) - UUID of the user group assigned to perform inventory work orders
                                                                                  • topologyConnectionTypes (list) - list of available topology connection types.
                                                                                    • id (string) - UUID of the connection type, if ID specified updates existing connection type, while not specifying ID (or specifying it as null) creates new connection type
                                                                                    • name (string) - name of the connection type
                                                                                    • shortcut (string) - short name of the connection type
                                                                                    • kind (string) - kind of the connection type, one of “L1”, “L2”, “VIRTUAL”
                                                                                  • intervalToRunEndMandatoryTask (number) - execution offset in seconds from the end of a reservation for mandatory teardown tasks that should run near end of reservation
                                                                                  • mandatoryAutomationTasks (list) - list of mandatory startup and teardown automation tasks
                                                                                    • id (string) - UUID of the task
                                                                                    • type (string) - task type, one of “MANDATORY_AT_START” or “MANDATORY_NEAR_END”
                                                                                    • testCaseId (string) - test case UUID
                                                                                    • parameters (list) - parameters of the test case
                                                                                      • name (string) - name of the parameter
                                                                                      • value (string) - value of the parameter
                                                                                      • description (string) - description of the parameter
                                                                                  • tokenForMaintenance (string) - token for maintenance, should have admin level rights
                                                                                  • timeoutPeriodToReleaseLicenseMinutes (number) - timeout period, after which application have the ability to release the license from user if somebody else can not login
                                                                                  • enforceAutoLogoutAfterIdleTime (boolean) - enforce auto-logout independent of available licenses if true
                                                                                  • triggeredAutomationTasks (list) - list of triggered automation tasks with specified events which would trigger tasks execution
                                                                                    • id (string) - UUID of the task
                                                                                    • eventType (string) - type of event which will trigger task execution, one of specified in triggeredEventTypeList
                                                                                    • testCaseId (string) - test case UUID
                                                                                    • parameters (list) - parameters of the test case
                                                                                      • name (string) - name of the parameter
                                                                                      • value (string) - value of the parameter
                                                                                      • description (string) - description of the parameter
                                                                                  • triggeredEventTypeList (list) - list of event types, which could trigger automation tasks execution
                                                                                    • id (string) - enum constant id of the event type
                                                                                    • interval (number) - exists only for “ON_RESERVATION_APPROACHING_END”, defines time interval before reservation ends in seconds, when assigned tasks should be triggered
                                                                                    • definedParameters (array) - names of parameters which would be provided by server to every test case assigned to the event type
                                                                                  • allowReservationsFromInventory (boolean) - if this flag is true then users are able to reserve individual pieces of equipment from the Inventory page

                                                                                  Returns:

                                                                                  Application settings with the same fields as if returned by GET /settings

                                                                                  Error Codes:

                                                                                  • BUILTIN_CONNECTION_TYPE_MODIFICATION - when trying to update built-in topology connection type
                                                                                  • FIELD_NOT_UNIQUE - topology connection type with same name or same shortcut already exists
                                                                                  • INVALID_APPLICATION_SETTING_VALUE - value of the specified application setting is not valid
                                                                                  • CONNECTION_TYPE_NOT_FOUND - specified connection type was not found

                                                                                  Job Service v1

                                                                                  /job/{jobId}

                                                                                  Access Level: User

                                                                                  • status (string) - one of “SUCCESS”, “FAILURE”, “SCHEDULED”

                                                                                    string (required) 

                                                                                    UUID of the job to retrieve

                                                                                    GET

                                                                                    Access Level: User

                                                                                    The same fields as for cloud of GET /clouds, but optionally with vunits with following fields:

                                                                                    • vunits (list) - List of general virtual units of the cloud (WARNING: The includeUnits parameter is experimental. We do not provide backward compatibility guarantees for this.):
                                                                                      • id (string) - ID of the virtual unit
                                                                                      • cloudId (string) - ID of the cloud
                                                                                      • type (string) - Virtual unit type. Supported types: VIRTUAL_PUBLIC_NETWORK, VIRTUAL_NETWORK, VIRTUAL_ROUTER, VIRTUAL_MACHINE, VIRTUAL_ROUTER_PORT, VIRTUAL_MACHINE_PORT
                                                                                      • name (string) - name of the virtual unit
                                                                                      • description (string) - description of the virtual unit
                                                                                      • isSingleton (boolean) - prohibits the use of the virtual unit more than once in topology
                                                                                      • iconId (string) - UUID of the virtual unit icon

                                                                                    Error Codes:

                                                                                    • CLOUD_NOT_FOUND - specified cloud is not found
                                                                                    • Parameters
                                                                                    • includeUnits
                                                                                      boolean (optional) Default: false 

                                                                                      when true, vunits section will be included into response body, containing list of virtual units in the cloud.                                                                                       GET

                                                                                      POST
                                                                                      /vm_template/

                                                                                      Creates and returns a new VM template

                                                                                      Full URL: /velocity/api/cloud/v2/vm_template/

                                                                                      Access Level: User

                                                                                      Request Body:

                                                                                      JSON object containing the following fields:

                                                                                      • name (string) - name of the VM template
                                                                                      • description (string) - description of the VM template
                                                                                      • iconId (string) - id of the template icon
                                                                                      • cloudId (string) - id of a cloud the template is related to
                                                                                      • availabilityZone (string) - a zone where the VM is launched
                                                                                      • keyPair (string) - key pair to login to the VM via SSH
                                                                                      • securityGroups (string) - security group names delimited with comma
                                                                                      • customizationScript (string) - a customization script
                                                                                      • hardwareProfileId (string) - id of the virtual hardware profile related to the specified cloud
                                                                                      • minCores (integer) - minimal number of cores for the template to be used
                                                                                      • minRamMB (integer) - minimal RAM for the template to be used
                                                                                      • minDiskGB (integer) - minimal disk space for the template to be used
                                                                                      • imageId (string) - virtual machine image id related to the specified cloud
                                                                                      • osFamilyMatch (string) - search string for the virtual machine image by the operating system family, with regex supported
                                                                                      • osVersionMatch (string) - search string for the version of the operating system to launch inside the template VM, with regex supported
                                                                                      • imageNameMatch (string) - search string for the name of the VM image, with regex supported
                                                                                      • customPropertiesMatch (string) - search string for custom properties of the template, with regex supported

                                                                                      Returns:

                                                                                      Newly created VM template, the same as if returned by GET /vm_template/{vmTemplateId}

                                                                                        POST
                                                                                        /cloud/{cloudId}/image

                                                                                        Creates new image. Uploads image source from URL if URL is provided, otherwise creates image without source file, source file have to be provided later by PUT request with image file in request body. Status of uploading can be monitored by status field.

                                                                                        Full URL: /velocity/api/cloud/v2/cloud/{cloudId}/image

                                                                                        Access Level: User

                                                                                        Request Body:

                                                                                        JSON object with subset of the following fields:

                                                                                        • image (object) - image object
                                                                                          • name (string, required) - name of the image
                                                                                          • description (string) - description of the image
                                                                                          • format (string, required) - image disk format, one of AKI, AMI, ARI, ISO, QCOW2, RAW, VDI, VHD, VMDK
                                                                                          • minRamMb (number, required) - image min RAM size, in MBs
                                                                                          • minDiskGb (number, required) - image min disk size, in GBs
                                                                                          • isPublic (boolean, required) - image visibility
                                                                                        • url (string) - image source url

                                                                                        Returns:

                                                                                        JSON object with the following fields:

                                                                                        • id (string) - image id in cloud
                                                                                        • name (string) - name of the image
                                                                                        • description (string) - description of the image
                                                                                        • status (string) - image status, one of EMPTY, SAVING, ACTIVE, DELETING, UNKNOWN
                                                                                        • format (string) - image disk format, one of AKI, AMI, ARI, ISO, QCOW2, RAW, VDI, VHD, VMDK
                                                                                        • minRamMb (number) - image min RAM size, in MBs
                                                                                        • minDiskGb (number) - image min disk size, in GBs
                                                                                        • isPublic (boolean) - image visibility

                                                                                        Tags:

                                                                                        • asynchronous if url is provided

                                                                                        Error Codes:

                                                                                        • CLOUD_NOT_FOUND - specified cloud was not found
