                                                                                        PUT
                                                                                        /cloud/{cloudId}/image/{imageId}

                                                                                        Uploads image source based on the input.

                                                                                        Full URL: /velocity/api/cloud/v2/cloud/{cloudId}/image/{imageId}

                                                                                        Access Level: User

                                                                                        Request Body:

                                                                                        Binary image source data.

                                                                                        Note: Image data can be uploaded by chunks. Chunks must be uploaded in natural order. This can be useful to avoid connection timeouts and errors caused by web server limit for max request size. Current chunk start, end and total bytes must be passed via Content-Range header parameter.

                                                                                        Error Codes:

                                                                                        • CLOUD_NOT_FOUND - specified cloud was not found

                                                                                        Required header parameters:

                                                                                        • Content-Length (required, number) - size of image source (when upload all binary content)
                                                                                        • Content-Range (required, string) - range of current data chunk (when upload binary content by chunks)
                                                                                        • Response  200

                                                                                        /cloud_unit/{unitId}

                                                                                          • description (string) - description of the property
                                                                                          • type (string) - one of “TEXT”, “TEXT_AREA”, “BOOLEAN”, “DECIMAL”, “INTEGER”, “ATTACHMENT”, “PASSWORD” or “DROP_DOWN_LIST”

                                                                                          • isImportant (boolean) - true, if the property is important, false otherwise. It is a hint for UI developer that given property is primary for a given cloud unit.

                                                                                        Work Order Service v4 

                                                                                        Work Order Service provides access to work orders

                                                                                        GET
                                                                                        /work_orders

                                                                                        Lists all work orders for the specified time period

                                                                                        Full URL: /velocity/api/work_order/v4/work_orders

                                                                                        Access Level: User

                                                                                        Returns:

                                                                                        • total (number) - total number of work orders
                                                                                        • offset (number) - offset of the current page
                                                                                        • count (number) - number of items on the page
                                                                                        • workOrders (list)
                                                                                          • id (string) - UUID of the work order
                                                                                          • name (string) - name of the work order. Currently name equals to work order number
                                                                                          • type (string) - one of the “RESERVATION”, “INVENTORY”
                                                                                          • notes (string) - work order notes
                                                                                          • created (number) - timestamp when the work order was created
                                                                                          • requesterId (string) - UUID of the user who requested the work order
                                                                                          • status (string) - one of the “PENDING”, “ACCEPTED”, “COMPLETED”, “DECLINED”, “FAILED”, “CANCELED”
                                                                                          • failureReason (string) - reason of work order failure. null if work order status is “PENDING”, “ACCEPTED” or “COMPLETED”
                                                                                          • assigneeId (string) - UUID of the user who assigned to perform the work order
                                                                                          • startAfter (number) - timestamp when work order should be start. null for work order of “INVENTORY” type
                                                                                          • completeBefore (number) - timestamp when work order should be completed. null for work order of “INVENTORY” type
                                                                                          • completionDate (number) - timestamp when work order been marked as completed. null if work order status is not “COMPLETED”
                                                                                          • lastStatusUpdated (number) - last status modification timestamp
                                                                                          • isTruncated (boolean) - true if the number of actions coming from a CSV import has been capped to a maximum value (in which case notes contain additional information), false otherwise

                                                                                        Tags:

                                                                                        • pageable
                                                                                        • sortable by any field
                                                                                        • filterable by any field except id, startAfter, created, completeBefore, completedAt
                                                                                        • Parameters
                                                                                        • searchString
                                                                                          string (optional) 

                                                                                          if specified, only work orders whose names match the string are returned

                                                                                          minCreated
                                                                                          number (optional) 

                                                                                          timestamp > created

                                                                                          maxCompleteBefore
                                                                                          number (optional) 

                                                                                          timestamp < completeBefore

                                                                                        GET
                                                                                        /work_order/{workOrderIdOrNum}/actions

                                                                                        Returns work order required action list

                                                                                        Full URL: /velocity/api/work_order/v4/work_order/{workOrderIdOrNum}/actions

                                                                                        Access Level: User

                                                                                        Returns:

                                                                                        • total (number) - total number of work order actions
                                                                                        • offset (number) - offset of the current page
                                                                                        • count (number) - number of items on the page
                                                                                        • workOrderActions (list)
                                                                                          • id (string) - UUID of the work order action
                                                                                          • type (string) - one of the “CONNECT”, “DISCONNECT”, “EXISTING_CONNECTION”
                                                                                          • port1Id (string) - UUID of the port used to perform the action
                                                                                          • linkPlace1 (string) - the link place of port, for patch panels can be “BACK” or “FRONT”, for other devices always “BACK”
                                                                                          • port2Id (string) - UUID of the port used to perform the action (can be null if type is “DISCONNECT”)
                                                                                          • linkPlace2 (string) - the link place of port, for patch panels can be “BACK” or “FRONT”, for other devices always “BACK”
                                                                                          • cableId (string) - UUID of an existent cable (can be null if type is “CONNECT” or cable isn’t specified for the physical link)
                                                                                          • cableTypeId (string) - UUID of an existent cable type (can be null if type is “CONNECT” or cable type isn’t specified for the physical link)
                                                                                          • cable (object) - cable object. Represented similarly to GET /cable/{cableid}
                                                                                          • cableType (object) - cable type object. Represented similarly to GET /cable_type/{cableTypeId}
                                                                                          • port1 (object) - info about first port, the same info as returned by GET /device/{deviceId}/ports plus:
                                                                                            • deviceInterface (string) - the port device interface, one of “NONE”, “MANAGEMENT”, “LAYER1_SWITCH”, “LAYER2_SWITCH”, “CONFIGURABLE”, “CONFIGURABLE_LAYER1_SWITCH”, “CONFIGURABLE_LAYER2_SWITCH”, “PATCH_PANEL”
                                                                                            • deviceLocation (string) - location of the port device
                                                                                          • port2 (object) - info about second port, the same info as returned by GET /device/{deviceId}/ports plus:
                                                                                            • deviceInterface (string) - the port device interface, one of “NONE”, “MANAGEMENT”, “LAYER1_SWITCH”, “LAYER2_SWITCH”, “CONFIGURABLE”, “CONFIGURABLE_LAYER1_SWITCH”, “CONFIGURABLE_LAYER2_SWITCH”, “PATCH_PANEL”
                                                                                            • deviceLocation (string) - location of the port device

                                                                                        Error Codes:

                                                                                        • WORK_ORDER_NOT_FOUND - work order with specified ID or number does not exist

                                                                                        Tags:

                                                                                        • pageable
                                                                                        • filterable by id, type
                                                                                        • Parameters
                                                                                        • workOrderIdOrNum
                                                                                          string (required) 

                                                                                          UUID or number of the work order

                                                                                          expandedPorts
                                                                                          boolean (optional) Default: false 

                                                                                          when true, port1 and port2 are included for every work order action

                                                                                        • Response  200Toggle

                                                                                        POST
                                                                                        /work_order/{workOrderIdOrNum}/action

                                                                                        Updates work order status. Status can be updated for work orders with “PENDING” or “ACCEPTED” status only.

                                                                                        Full URL: /velocity/api/work_order/v4/work_order/{workOrderIdOrNum}/action

                                                                                        Access Level: User

                                                                                        Request Body: JSON object with any subset of the following fields:

                                                                                        • type (string, required) - new status for work order. Can be one of the “ACCEPT”, “COMPLETE”, “DECLINE”, “CANCEL”
                                                                                        • reason (string, optional) - reason of status change. Mandatory if type field is “DECLINE” or “CANCEL”, meaningless otherwise
                                                                                        • assignedCables (list, optional) - when type field is “COMPLETE” the list specifies cables for using with work order actions.
                                                                                          • workOrderActionId (string) - UUID of an existent work order action
                                                                                          • cableId (string) - UUID of an existent cable
                                                                                          • cableTypeId (string) - UUID of an existent cable type

                                                                                        Error Codes

                                                                                        • WORK_ORDER_NOT_FOUND - work order with specified ID or number does not exist
                                                                                        • WORK_ORDER_ALREADY_ACCEPTED - work order cannot be accepted because it is no longer pending
                                                                                        • WORK_ORDER_CANNOT_BE_DECLINED - work order cannot be declined because it is not pending
                                                                                        • WORK_ORDER_IS_NOT_ACCEPTED - work order cannot be declined because it has not been accepted
                                                                                        • WORK_ORDER_CANNOT_BE_CANCELLED - work order cannot be canceled after its start time
                                                                                        • Parameters
                                                                                        • workOrderIdOrNum
                                                                                          string (required) 

                                                                                          UUID or number of the work order

                                                                                        • RequestToggle
                                                                                        • Body
                                                                                              {
      "type": "ACCEPT",
      "reason": null,
      "assignedCables": [
          {
              "workOrderActionId": "62f1931a-972f-11e5-93aa-8fd49bcbe35d",
              "cableId": null,
              "cableTypeId": "e79a071e-9973-11e5-a0cc-0fc74b9b2f5f"
          }
      ]
    }
                                                                                        • Response  200
                                                                                        PUT
                                                                                        /work_order/{workOrderIdOrNum}/assignee

                                                                                        Updates work order assignee. Assignee can be updated for work orders with “PENDING” or “ACCEPTED” status only.

                                                                                        Full URL: /velocity/api/work_order/v4/work_order/{workOrderIdOrNum}/assignee

                                                                                        Access Level: User

                                                                                        Error Codes

                                                                                        • WORK_ORDER_NOT_FOUND - work order with specified ID or number does not exist
                                                                                        • TECHNICIAN_OF_MANAGER_EXPECTED - assignee does not belong to a technician user group
                                                                                        • WORK_ORDER_CANNOT_BE_REASSIGNED - work order cannot be reassigned because it is finished
                                                                                        • Parameters
                                                                                        • workOrderIdOrNum
                                                                                          string (required) 

                                                                                          UUID or number of the work order

                                                                                          assigneeId
                                                                                          string (required) 

                                                                                          UUID of new work order assignee

                                                                                          Repository Service v1 

                                                                                          The Repository Service stores and manages project data. In Version 1 test cases, parameter files and their metadata are available through the API.

                                                                                          Incompatibilities with v0

                                                                                          Version 6.0 of the Repository Service no longer supports the v0 API. In addition, the v1 API makes several changes which are not backward compatible with the v0 API. The following changes from v0 to v1 might cause compatibility problems.

                                                                                          • Attribute names in v0 are snake case. In v1 they are camel case to agree with other services. For example, “latest_update_time” in v0 is “latestUpdateTime” in v1.
                                                                                          • Every resource in v1 is stored in a repository. (In Velocity 6.0 the only repository is “main”.) The repository name is always the first element of a path. Thus v0 /repository/{file_path} in v1 is /repository/main/{file_path}
                                                                                          • The fullPath attribute in v1 will include repository name. Thus a v0 full_path value of /{project}/{file_path} in v1 is {repositoryName}/{project}/{file_path} (e.g. main/my_project/test_cases/my_test.fftc)
                                                                                          • v0 “itar” type is replaced in v1 by “project”.
                                                                                          • In v1 collection endpoints support Velocity Home pagination.
                                                                                            • They no longer support the “full” parameter.
                                                                                            • In v0 collections return total, start, and end. In v1 they return total, offset, and count.
                                                                                          • The v0 /testcases/{resource_guid}/parameters endpoint no longer exists. Instead it has been replaced with the “parameters” parameter on a test case path, or /repository/{test_case_path}?parameters=true.
                                                                                          • The filter parameter logic has been modified in v1 to agree with Velocity home.
                                                                                            • In v0 joining filter conditions with the pipe symbol (|) signified conjunction (AND).
                                                                                            • In v1 the pipe symbol (|) signifies disjunction (OR). For example, v0 “filter=project:my_project|user:jsmith” finds all resources in my_project AND owned by jsmith. In v1 the same filter would find all resources which are either in my_project OR owned by jsmith.
                                                                                            • In v1 conjunction is represented by multiple filter parameters. For example, in v0 “filter=user::jsmith|type_name::fftc” finds all resources owned by jsmith AND have type fftc. In v1 the equivalent form is “filter=user::jsmith&filter=typeName::fftc”
                                                                                            • v0 “:in:” operator is no longer supported. Instead use the OR facility. For example, v0 “filter=type_name:in:fftc,ffpt,tbml” becomes in v1 “filter=typeName::fftc|typeName::ffpt|typeName::tbml”
                                                                                            • While not exactly incompatible, API users should also be aware that in v1 full text search is supported for some attributes. The general effect is to provide better natural language type search and allow some fuzzy matching. However, for any given search the results may vary slightly from v0. The affected attributes are described in the primary documentation.
                                                                                          • Besides the change from snake to camel case, the following attribute changes were made in v1.
                                                                                            • All resources
                                                                                              • Added in v1
                                                                                                • project name of project. Roughly replaces project_path since projects are always top level and project_path can be inferred from project.
                                                                                                • repository name of repository.
                                                                                              • Removed in v1
                                                                                                • owner duplicates user
                                                                                                • path duplicates fullPath.
                                                                                                • project_path roughly replaced by project
                                                                                            • Test cases
                                                                                              • Removed itar_path. Use project instead.
                                                                                            • Parameter files
                                                                                              • Removed itar_path. Use project instead.

                                                                                          Resource Collections

                                                                                          The Repository Service stores many different kinds of resources. Every resource has the following attribute fields available for search and returned with the resource.

                                                                                          Returns:

                                                                                          • fullPath (string) - full API path of a resource. A full API consists of {repositoryName}/{project}/{filePath}. For example, a fullPath value might be main/my_project/test_cases/my_test.fftc
                                                                                          • guid (string) - unique ID of test case in repository
                                                                                          • latestUpdateTime (number) - time stamp of milliseconds since the Linux epoch
                                                                                          • name (string) - short file name (no path) of resource.
                                                                                          • project (string) - name of the project in which resource is contained
                                                                                          • repository (string) - name of the repository in which resource is stored
                                                                                          • typeName (string) - name of the resource type. As of 6.0 the following values are supported: project (project, formerly itar), fftc (test case), ffpt (parameter file), ffsp (session profile), tbml (topology)
                                                                                          • uploadVersion (string) - unique ID that identifies which upload this resource is associated with
                                                                                          • user (string) - ID of user who uploaded resource
                                                                                          • userDomain (string) - domain of user who uploaded resource

                                                                                          Parameters Collections 

                                                                                          List Parameters For Test Case
                                                                                          GET
                                                                                          /repository/{resourcePath}?parameters=true

                                                                                          Display a list of parameters for one resource obtained from above method. The resource can be a test case or a parameter file. The resource is identified by its path in the repository service. A path begins with a repository name and project name, and continues with the path within the project (equivalent to the path within an itar uploaded from iTest). For example, say the testcase_parameters project (itar) is uploaded to the main repository. Within the project new_testcase.fftc is in the test_cases folder. Then the full API path (resourcePath) for the test case is main/testcase_parameters/test_cases/new_testcase.fftc. To retrieve the test case parameters use the URL /repository/main/testcase_parameters/test_cases/new_testcase.fftc?parameters=true

                                                                                          Full URL: /ito/repository/v1/repository/{resourcePath}?parameters=true

                                                                                          Access Level: User

                                                                                          Returns:

                                                                                          • parameters (list) - parameters of the test case
                                                                                            • name (string) - name of the parameter
                                                                                            • value (string) - value of the parameter
                                                                                            • description (string) - description of the parameter
                                                                                            • parameters (list) - child parameters of the parameter. Each child has above values. Child parameters can be nested to an arbitrary depth.

                                                                                          Error Codes:

                                                                                          • INVALID_FILE_PATH - specified resourcePath was not valid.
                                                                                          • FILE_NOT_FOUND - there is no resource with the specified path.

                                                                                          Execution Service v1 

                                                                                          Execution Service is the liaison between the user and the execution engine. It accepts requests to run/view/cancel test cases.

                                                                                          EXECUTION COLLECTION 

                                                                                          List Executions
                                                                                          GET
                                                                                          /ito/executions/v1/executions?offset=<offset>&limit=<limit>&filter=<filter>

                                                                                          Retrieve a list of execution records.

                                                                                          Returns

                                                                                          • offset (number) - Index (0-based) of the first execution record in the content portion of the response.
                                                                                          • count (number) - Number of execution records in the content portion of the response.
                                                                                          • total (boolean) - The total number of execution records matching the filter criteria.
                                                                                          • content (list) - List of execution records, each record is in same data format as in GET Individual Execution

                                                                                          Tags:

                                                                                          • pageable
                                                                                          • filterable-limit by all valid field names
                                                                                          • sortable-limit on any attribute
                                                                                          • Parameters
                                                                                          • offset
                                                                                            number (optional) Default: 0 

                                                                                            Index (0-based) of the first desired from the filtered executions.

                                                                                            limit
                                                                                            number (optional) Default: 10 

                                                                                            Maximum number of executions to return. May not exceed 200.

                                                                                            filter
                                                                                            string (optional) 

                                                                                            Specifies a subset of executions to return (e.g., executionState::COMPLETED specifies all completed executions)

                                                                                          EXECUTIONS 

                                                                                          Queue an Execution
                                                                                          POST
                                                                                          /ito/executions/v1/executions

                                                                                          Add an execution to the execution queue.

                                                                                          The dispatching process attempts to maximize throughput. The dispatcher is able to send tests to more than one agent simultaneously. As a result, even though test 1 was queued before test 2, test 2 may win the race to begin execution on any available/capable agent. It is possible for a fast agent to begin running a test before a slow agent even if the two requests arrived at the respective agents at the exact same moment in time. The service does not force executions to begin in perfect lock-step with respect to the order in which they were queued as this would be detrimental to the number of executions that can run per unit time.

                                                                                          An execution which is queued can be associated with a reservation using one of the following two methodologies.

                                                                                          • The API client creates a reservation, either through the reservation service API or the Velocity GUI. The execution is informed of this reservation by setting the reservationID attribute in the POST body. Resources or topologies from the reservation can be used by the test being run during execution. Extend reservation: The execution agent may extend the reservation, if it detects that the reservation will expire before test completion. Beyond that, it is the responsibility of the API client to manage the reservation life cycle, including stopping the reservation after execution is finished.

                                                                                          • Set either the topologyId attribute (with a topology ID) or topologyVersionId attribute (with a topology version ID) in the POST body. In this case, the execution service will create a reservation for the topology immediately before execution and stop the reservation once execution is finished. Under this methodology, the execution agent will also extend the reservation when needed as described above. The API client does not need to manage any aspect of the reservation process.

                                                                                          Headers

                                                                                          Accept: application/json (default: application/xml)

                                                                                          Request Body:

                                                                                          JSON object with a subset of the following fields:

                                                                                          • callbackURL (optional, string) - A URL to which notifications are POSTed. See Execution Notifications for details.
                                                                                          • detailLevel (optional, string) - The level of report detail that the execution agent should provide. If specified the value must be one of the following settings:
                                                                                            - ALL_ISSUES_ALL_STEPS All execution issues and steps. This is the maximum level of detail.
                                                                                            - ALL_ISSUES_ERROR_STEPS All execution issues and steps that indicate an error. This is the default when a detailLevel is not specified.
                                                                                            - ERROR_ISSUES_ONLY Only ERROR-level execution issues, and no step information.
                                                                                            - ERROR_ISSUES_WITH_STEPS Only ERROR-level execution issues, and any steps associated with those issues.
                                                                                            - REPORT_ONLY Only the report-level details such as executionState, result, etc. but no execution issue or step information. This is the minimum level of detail. Report-level details are also included with the other settings.
                                                                                          • parameterFilePath (optional, string) - Path pointing to parameter file
                                                                                          • parametersList (optional, list) - List of parameters, each one can have its own parameter. No individual parameter value may exceed 4,000 characters in length.
                                                                                          • reservationID (optional, string) - Reservation ID
                                                                                          • testPath (required, string) - Path string pointing to testcase
                                                                                          • topologyId (optional, string) - UUID of the topology to reserve and use for execution. If specified then reservationID, topologyVersionId, and topologyPath must not be specified. The version of the topology which is current at the time of the POST is used for the execution.
                                                                                          • topologyVersionId (optional, string) - UUID of the topology version to reserve. If specified then reservationID, topologyId, and topologyPath must not be specified. This attribute can be used for a current or former version of a topology, but is most useful for former versions.
                                                                                          • topologyPath (optional, string) - URI of the topology to use for execution. If specified then topologyId and topologyVersionId must not be specified. The URI must point to the Velocity repository. A specified topology cannot be reserved but will be associated with the the test case when it is run. It is possible to specify a reservationID with a topology path.
                                                                                          • testCategory (optional, string) - Category of test. Default to STANDARD (for normal test execution). Can be RESERVATION_STARTUP (used by Reservation Service for startup automation) or RESERVATION_TEARDOWN (used by Reservation Service for teardown automation). For internal use only.

                                                                                          Returns: Same as return of Individual Execution

                                                                                          • RequestToggle
                                                                                          • Headers

   "detailLevel":"ALL_ISSUES_ERROR_STEPS",
   "parameterFilePath":null,
   "parametersList":[

         "description":null,

            {
               "name":"child",

            }

      }

                                                                                          INDIVIDUAL EXECUTION 

                                                                                          Get an Execution
                                                                                          GET
                                                                                          /ito/executions/v1/executions/{executionId}

                                                                                          Retrieve a single execution record.

                                                                                          Returns

                                                                                          • callbackURL (string) - A URL to which notifications are POSTed. See Execution Notifications for details. Null if no callback URL was provided by the execution request.
                                                                                          • domain (string) - Domain value, default to ldap
                                                                                          • executionID (string) - ID for this execution record
                                                                                          • executionState (string) - Current state for this execution record. executionState can be one of: NOT_BEGUN, IN_PROGRESS, DISPATCHING, START_FAILED, COMPLETED, ABORTED, AGENT_NOT_RESPONDING
                                                                                          • executionLastUnsatisfiedCondition (string) - Last unsatisfied condition. executionLastUnsatisfiedCondition can be one of: NOT_YET_PROCESSED, NO_MATCHING_AGENT_AVAILABLE, RESERVATION_NOT_AVAILABLE, TOPOLOGY_CANNOT_BE_RESERVED, CAN_EXECUTE
                                                                                          • failureReason (string) - Reason for the failure. Filtering on this field includes non-exact matches.
                                                                                          • parameterFilePath (string) - Path of parameter file
                                                                                          • percentageComplete (number) - Percentage completed at moment
                                                                                          • reportID (string) - ID of report associated with this execution
                                                                                          • reportFormat (string) - Report format, can be XML or HTML
                                                                                          • reservationID (string) - Reservation ID associated with this execution
                                                                                          • testID (string) - Test ID for this execution
                                                                                          • testPath (string) - Path of testcase
                                                                                          • topologyId (string) - If specified in original POST, the UUID of the topology to reserve. Not present if reservationID, topologyVersionId, or topologyPath was specified.
                                                                                          • topologyReservationId (string) - Reservation ID associated with this execution when the reservation is obtained by the service. The reservation is obtained by the service when either the topologyId attribute or topologyVersionId attribute are specified in the original POST body. Not present if reservationID was specified in the original POST, or if execution has not begun.
                                                                                          • topologyVersionId (string) - The UUID of the version of the topology to reserve. If specified in original POST same as the POST value. If topologyId was specified in the original POST the version that was current at the time of the POST. Not present if reservationID or topologyPath was specified.
                                                                                          • topologyPath (string) - If specified in original POST, the URI of the topology to reserve. Not present if reservationID was specified.
                                                                                          • userID (string) - User ID for the person who triggered this execution
                                                                                          • parametersList (list) - List of parameters, this is nested structure if parameter has children parameters, each parameter has following fields:
                                                                                            - name (string) Name of parameter
                                                                                            - value (String) Value of the parameter
                                                                                            - parameters (list) List of its own parameters
                                                                                          • Parameters
                                                                                          • executionId
                                                                                            string (required) 

                                                                                            ID of the execution record

                                                                                          • Response  200Toggle

                                                                                          Cancel an Execution
                                                                                          DELETE
                                                                                          /ito/executions/v1/executions/{executionId}

                                                                                          Cancel/Abort an execution if it is still running. If aborted, executionState changes to “Aborted” (Has no effect on execution if it has already run).

                                                                                          • Parameters
                                                                                          • executionId
                                                                                            string (required) 

                                                                                            ID of the execution record

                                                                                          • Response  200
                                                                                          • Response  410Toggle

                                                                                          • When a matching execution record is found, however it is already aborted

                                                                                            Headers
                                                                                            Content-Type: application/json
                                                                                            Body
                                                                                            {
    "status": 410,
    "errorID": "EXECUTION_ALREADY_CANCELLED",
    "message": [
        "This execution has already been cancelled!"
    ],
    "moreInfo": "",
    "internalMessage": null
}

                                                                                          Execution Notifications 

                                                                                          NOTIFICATIONS 

                                                                                          The execution service POSTs notifications to the callback URL specified in an execution request. Any response to the POST is ignored by the service. The following notifications are sent if a URL is supplied.

                                                                                          START 

                                                                                          Execution has started.

                                                                                          • Response (application/json)

                                                                                              {
     "executionID": "1234",
     "eventType": "EXECUTION_START",
     "reportID": "1234",
     "executionStart": 1429223430,
     "agent": "23"
  }

                                                                                          ISSUE 

                                                                                          This notification provides notice about events that happen during execution like “Test has run for 4 second(s).” severity value can be one of “ERROR”, “INFORMATION” or “WARNING”.

                                                                                          • Response (application/json)

                                                                                              {
     "executionID": "1234",
     "eventType": "EXECUTION_ISSUE",
     "reportID": "1234",
     "timestamp": 1429223637,
     "severity": "INFORMATION",
     "message": "The number of packets matched expected value of 500"
  }

                                                                                          COMPLETE 

                                                                                          Execution has completed. executionStatus mirrors the result of test execution, therefore the value can be one of “ABORT”, “CANCEL”, “ERROR”, “FAIL”, “INDETERMINATE” or “PASS”.

                                                                                          • Response (application/json)

                                                                                              {
     "executionID": "1234",
     "eventType": "EXECUTION_COMPLETE",
     "reportID": "1234",
     "executionEnd": 1429223950,
     "duration": 300,
     "executionStatus": "PASS"
  }

                                                                                          Reporting Service v1 

                                                                                          The Reporting Service manages execution reports. With its API users may get report summary data, child reports, and detailed XML or HTML reports.

                                                                                          Incompatibilities with v0

                                                                                          The v1 Reporting Service no longer supports the v0 API. In addition, the v1 API makes a couple of changes which are not backward compatible with the v0 API. This section documents those changes.

                                                                                          • Attribute names in v0 are snake case. In v1 they are camel case to agree with other services. For example, “latest_update_time” in v0 is “latestUpdateTime” in v1.
                                                                                          • The v0 endpoint /reports/{reportId}/files to get all the files associated with a report is no longer supported.
                                                                                          • The v0 endpoint /reports/{reportId}/files/{filename} to get a file associated with a report is no longer supported.

                                                                                          Report Summary Data 

                                                                                          Get Report Summary
                                                                                          GET
                                                                                          /reports/{reportId}

                                                                                          Retrieve a summary representation of a report.

                                                                                          Full URL: /ito/reporting/v1/reports/{reportId}

                                                                                          Returns

                                                                                          • guid (string) - ID of the report
                                                                                          • parentReport (string) - ID of the parent report
                                                                                          • executionId (string) - ID of the related execution
                                                                                          • testId (string) - ID of the related test case
                                                                                          • testPath (string) - Path to the related test case
                                                                                          • startTime (number) - Timestamp when the execution started
                                                                                          • endTime (number) - Timestamp when the execution finished
                                                                                          • result (string) - Outcome of the test; one of: “ABORT”, “CANCEL”, “ERROR”, “FAIL”, “INDETERMINATE”, “PASS”
                                                                                          • status (string) - Status of the execution; one of: “ABORTED”, “AGENT_NOT_RESPONDING”, “COMPLETED”, “IN_PROGRESS”, “NOT_BEGUN”, DISPATCHING
                                                                                          • executor (string) - User who scheduled the execution
                                                                                          • agentId (string) - ID of the agent where the execution was performed. “Unknown” if the execution was aborted
                                                                                          • agentName (string) - Name of the agent where the execution was performed
                                                                                          • agentHost (string) - Hostname of the agent where the execution was performed
                                                                                          • topologyName (string) - Name of the topology associated with the test case
                                                                                          • failureReason (string) - If the execution failed or was aborted, this describes the reason. Filtering on this field includes non-exact matches.
                                                                                          • latestUpdateTime (number) - When the report was last updated
                                                                                          • parameterFilePath (string) - Parameter file location
                                                                                          • parameters (list) - List of parameters passed to the test case, each having the following fields:
                                                                                            - name (string) Name of parameter
                                                                                            - value (String) Value of the parameter
                                                                                            - description (String) Description of the parameter
                                                                                            - parameters (list) List of nested parameters sharing the same structure
                                                                                          • reportFileSource (string) - Where report files are stored. Possible values are ELASTIC and MONGO.
                                                                                          • parentStepIndex (string) - Index of parent step
                                                                                          • Parameters
                                                                                          • reportId
                                                                                            string (required) 

                                                                                            ID associated with a report

                                                                                          • Response  200Toggle
                                                                                          • Headers
                                                                                            Accept: text/html, application/xml
                                                                                            Body

                                                                                          • endTime (number) - Timestamp when the execution finished

                                                                                          • agentId (string) - ID of the agent where the execution was performed. “Unknown” if the execution was aborted
                                                                                          • agentName (string) - Name of the agent where the execution was performed

                                                                                          Report Detailed Data 

                                                                                          Get Report Details
                                                                                          GET
                                                                                          /reports/{reportId}/detail

                                                                                          Retrieve detailed data associated with a report. This data is conceptually similar to the data saved in a report by iTest. (However, it may differ from iTest report data in many details.) The data returned may be thought of as a dump of all data collected in a report during a test execution.

                                                                                          Full URL: /ito/reporting/v1/reports/{report_id}/detail

                                                                                          Headers

                                                                                          License Service v2 

                                                                                          License Service provides access to license information

                                                                                          GET
                                                                                          /summary

                                                                                          Returns basic license information

                                                                                          Full URL: /velocity/api/license/v2/summary

                                                                                          Access Level: Admin

                                                                                          Returns:

                                                                                          • licensedUserCount (number) - current number of licensed users
                                                                                          • maxLicensedUserCount (number) - maximum number of licensed users
                                                                                          • failures (number) - total count of unavailable licenses
                                                                                          • duration (number) - total duration of licenses usage in ms

                                                                                          Error Codes:

                                                                                          • UNABLE_TO_GET_MAX_COUNT_OF_USER_LICENSES - maximum number of licensed users cannot be returned
                                                                                          • Response  200Toggle
                                                                                          • Headers
                                                                                            Content-Type: application/json
                                                                                            Body
                                                                                                {
      "licensedUserCount": 3,
      "maxLicensedUserCount": 10.
      "duration": 12121221,
      "failures": 2
    }
                                                                                          GET
                                                                                          /audit

                                                                                          Returns audit information about license usage

                                                                                          Full URL: /velocity/api/license/v2/audit

                                                                                          Access Level: Admin

                                                                                          Returns:

                                                                                          • total (number) - total number of stored items
                                                                                          • offset (number) - offset of the current page
                                                                                          • count (number) - number of items on the page
                                                                                          • items (list)
                                                                                            • userId (string) - UUID of the user
                                                                                            • userRole (string) - role of the user
                                                                                            • userName (string) - name of the user
                                                                                            • timeUsed (number) - licenses were granted for user for this number of milliseconds
                                                                                            • checkoutsCount (number) - number of successful checkouts for user
                                                                                            • failures (number) - count of failures on checkout licenses for user
                                                                                            • active (boolean) - is currently license used by user

                                                                                          Tags:

                                                                                          • pageable
                                                                                          • sortable by any field
                                                                                          • filterable by userRole, userId

                                                                                            timestamp of the start date in a time period

                                                                                            endBefore
                                                                                            number (optional) 

                                                                                            timestamp of the end date in a time period (default - current time)
